title.zh: 比特币跌破6万美元，英伟达反弹行情熄火，24小时爆仓8.44亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as Nvidia-driven rally fades; $844 million liquidated in 24 hours

summary.zh: 比特币（BTC）周二回落至6万美元下方，抹去周一因英伟达（Nvidia）首席执行官黄仁勋复职而录得的全部涨幅，24小时内全网加密货币期货爆仓金额达8.44亿美元，较前一日增长217%（CoinGlass数据）。以太币（ETH）同步下跌约1.6%至1,695美元附近，CoinDesk 20指数下跌1.3%。分析师指出，比特币已连续七周下跌，短期内能否守住6万美元关口将成为关键考验。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell back below $60,000 on Tuesday, giving up all of Monday's gains sparked by Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, while $844 million in crypto futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours, up 217% from the day before, according to CoinGlass. Ether fell about 1.6% to around $1,695, and the CoinDesk 20 Index lost 1.3%. Analysts say whether bitcoin can hold the $60,000 level is the key near-term test after seven straight weeks of declines.

title.zh: CFTC允许比特币、以太坊及合规稳定币计入交易场所运营准备金
title.en: CFTC lets bitcoin, ether and payment stablecoins count toward venue operating reserves

summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）工作人员发布指引，允许受监管的衍生品交易所和清算机构将比特币（BTC）、以太币（ETH）及合规支付稳定币计入覆盖12个月运营成本的财务资源要求，其中比特币和以太币须按市值至少折价20%，合规稳定币折价2%。该指引明确，加密资产不能满足以现金或高流动性证券形式持有的流动性要求，且仅为工作人员意见，不构成委员会正式规则。
summary.en: Staff at the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) issued guidance allowing regulated derivatives exchanges and clearinghouses to count bitcoin, ether and qualifying payment stablecoins toward financial resources covering 12 months of operating costs, with a minimum 20% haircut for bitcoin and ether and 2% for qualifying payment stablecoins. The guidance makes clear crypto assets cannot satisfy the separate liquidity requirement, which must be held in cash or highly liquid securities, and that it is staff guidance rather than a formal Commission rule.

title.zh: Solana代币化股票规模达12.2亿美元，周交易量创18亿美元纪录
title.en: Solana tokenized equities reach $1.22 billion as weekly volume hits record $1.8 billion

summary.zh: Solana网络上的代币化股票（Tokenized Equities）流通规模已达12.2亿美元，约为10月底水平的两倍，周现货交易量创下18亿美元纪录，占全链代币化股票交易的43%。代币化Anthropic股票成为主要推动力，Backpack发行的ANT代币在上市首日交易量达1.347亿美元。Solana基金会表示，代币化股票的下一步在于借贷与收益等实际用途，而非仅作为持有资产。
summary.en: Circulating tokenized equities on Solana reached $1.22 billion, nearly double the level at the end of October, while weekly spot trading volume hit a record $1.8 billion, or 43% of all on-chain equities activity. Tokenized Anthropic stock was a key driver, with Backpack's ANT token recording $134.7 million in first-day trading. The Solana Foundation said the next step for tokenized stocks is real utility such as lending and yield, not just holding the assets.

title.zh: 币安11月25日进行钱包维护，全网提币暂停约1小时
title.en: Binance to suspend all-network withdrawals for about an hour during wallet maintenance on November 25

summary.zh: 币安（Binance）宣布将于11月25日06:00（UTC）进行钱包维护，期间全网提币服务将暂停，预计持续约60分钟，交易不受影响。币安表示，提币服务将在网络被确认稳定后恢复，且可能不再另行公告。此次维护距离10月底影响63亿美元资产的安全事件仅数周，币安称已完成受影响资产的赔付并发布了新的储备证明（Proof of Reserves）。
summary.en: Binance said it will perform wallet maintenance at 06:00 UTC on November 25, suspending withdrawals on all networks for an estimated 60 minutes, while trading will not be affected. The exchange said withdrawal services will resume once the network is deemed stable and that no further announcement may follow. The maintenance comes weeks after a late-October security incident affecting $6.3 billion in assets; Binance says it has completed coverage of affected assets and published a new proof of reserves.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF周一净流出5.7亿美元，11月流出创47.1亿美元月度纪录
title.en: Spot bitcoin ETFs see $570 million outflow on Monday as November total hits record $4.71 billion

summary.zh: 美国比特币现货ETF（Spot ETF）周一净流出5.697亿美元，为连续第五个交易日净流出，11月累计净流出达47.1亿美元，超过6月创下的45亿美元纪录，成为有记录以来流出最多的月份。贝莱德（BlackRock）的IBIT占当日流出的5.093亿美元，富达（Fidelity）的FBTC是唯一录得净流入的基金。同期以太坊现货ETF净流出8,496万美元。
summary.en: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $569.7 million in net outflows on Monday, a fifth straight session of withdrawals, taking November's total to $4.71 billion — surpassing June's $4.5 billion record for the worst month since the funds launched. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $509.3 million of the day's outflows, while Fidelity's FBTC was the only fund to record net inflows. Spot ether ETFs also saw $84.96 million in net outflows the same day.

title.zh: 贝莱德在香港推出首只代币化货币市场基金，规模1亿美元
title.en: BlackRock launches first tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong at $100 million

summary.zh: 贝莱德（BlackRock）宣布在香港推出首只代币化货币市场基金（Tokenized Money Market Fund）——贝莱德港元数字流动性基金（HKD Digital Liquidity Fund），截至11月20日规模为1亿美元。专业投资者可使用持牌港元稳定币HKDAP申购和赎回，渣打银行（Standard Chartered）与蚂蚁国际（Ant International）为种子投资者。这是贝莱德代币化货币基金业务首次进入亚太地区。
summary.en: BlackRock has opened its first tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong, the BlackRock HKD Digital Liquidity Fund, with $100 million in assets as of November 20. Professional investors can subscribe and redeem using HKDAP, a licensed Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin, with Standard Chartered and Ant International as seed investors. It is BlackRock's first tokenized money market fund in the Asia-Pacific region.

title.zh: 以太坊基金会安全团队扩编一倍，AI威胁被列为优先于量子计算
title.en: Ethereum Foundation doubles security team as AI threat moves ahead of quantum

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会（Ethereum Foundation）宣布已将协议安全团队规模扩大一倍，以推进应对人工智能（AI）与量子计算威胁的大规模协议升级。研究员Kev Wedderburn表示，AI发现软件漏洞的速度已超过人工审查，AI风险如今比量子计算更为紧迫，相关升级的难度超过2022年的合并（The Merge）。升级将涉及验证者签名、钱包授权及Rollup数据验证，内部目标仍为2029年完成过渡。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team to advance a major overhaul of the network's defenses against artificial intelligence and quantum computing threats. Researcher Kev Wedderburn said AI now finds software bugs faster than people can review them, making AI a more urgent risk than quantum computing, and called the upgrade harder than the 2022 Merge. The overhaul would change validator signing, wallet authorization and rollup data verification, with an internal target of completing the transition by 2029.

title.zh: OKX与ICE代币化证券平台上线，首批仅6只股票，67家发行人反对
title.en: OKXICE tokenized securities venue launches with six stocks as 67 issuers object

summary.zh: OKX与洲际交易所（ICE）的合资公司OKXICE于11月23日正式上线代币化证券平台（Tokenized Securities Venue），首批仅上线6只代币化股票，包括Coinbase、Strategy、Robinhood等，并以USDC结算。尽管平台规划了113只资产的分阶段目录，已有67家上市公司正式反对将其股票代币化。平台在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的创新豁免（Innovation Exemption）下运营，通过许可型Uniswap v4资金池提供24/7交易。
summary.en: OKXICE, the joint venture between OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), opened its tokenized securities venue on November 23, listing only six tokenized stocks at launch — including Coinbase, Strategy and Robinhood — settled against USDC. Although the platform has a 113-asset phased catalog, 67 listed companies have formally objected to having their shares tokenized. The venue operates under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, offering 24/7 trading through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools.

title.zh: GENIUS法案终版规则送交白宫审查，参议院举行SEC与CFTC提名人听证
title.en: GENIUS Act final rules reach White House review as Senate holds SEC and CFTC nominee hearings

summary.zh: 美国联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）与金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）的《GENIUS法案》终版实施细则已于11月18日送交白宫管理和预算办公室（OIRA）审查，距离该法2027年1月18日生效日仅剩61天。同期，参议院银行委员会与农业委员会分别就美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和CFTC提名人举行听证，议题包括代币化证券与预测市场。联邦与各州围绕预测市场的管辖权冲突也在升级，CFTC已起诉阿肯色州与路易斯安那州。
summary.en: Final GENIUS Act rules from the FDIC and FinCEN were sent to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA) for review on November 18, 61 days before the law takes effect on January 18, 2027. Meanwhile, the Senate Banking and Agriculture Committees held hearings on nominees to the SEC and CFTC, covering tokenized securities and prediction markets. The federal-state fight over prediction markets also escalated, with the CFTC suing Arkansas and Louisiana to block state enforcement against federally regulated exchanges.

title.zh: Visa推出实验性AI代理钱包，代理完成任务可赚取OUSD稳定币
title.en: Visa launches experimental AI agent wallet letting agents earn OUSD for paid tasks

summary.zh: Visa加密实验室（Visa Crypto Labs）推出实验性Visa CLI代理钱包（Agent Wallet），符合条件的美国Visa持卡人可验证AI代理并将其注册至Visa代理目录，代理完成有偿任务后可赚取美元稳定币Open USD（OUSD）。该钱包基于Tempo区块链与机器支付协议（Machine Payments Protocol）构建，任务通过Taskmarket等平台发布。目前该产品仅限受邀用户使用，Visa强调其仍处于实验阶段。
summary.en: Visa Crypto Labs launched an experimental Visa CLI agent wallet that lets eligible U.S. Visa cardholders verify AI agents and register them in Visa's Agent Directory, with agents earning Open USD (OUSD), a dollar-backed stablecoin, for completing paid tasks. The wallet is built on the Tempo blockchain using the Machine Payments Protocol, with tasks posted through marketplaces such as Taskmarket. Access is invitation-only, and Visa describes the product as experimental.

title.zh: BitMine以太坊持仓达608万枚，接近总供应量5%目标
title.en: BitMine's ETH holdings reach 6.09 million, nearing 5% of total supply

summary.zh: 上市公司BitMine Immersion Technologies（BitMine）宣布，上周再买入7,819枚以太币（ETH），总持仓达6,085,564枚，约占以太坊流通供应量（Circulating Supply）的4.98%，距离其5%的“Alchemy of 5%”目标仅一步之遥。公司表示自2025年6月启动以太坊财库战略（Treasury Strategy）以来每周持续买入，其中约86%的持仓已通过其MAVAN平台质押（Staking），预计年化质押收益约2.45亿美元。尽管以太币月内下跌约26%，其财库总价值仍达111亿美元，但持仓账面浮亏约96亿美元。
summary.en: BitMine Immersion Technologies said it bought another 7,819 ETH last week, lifting its holdings to 6,085,564 ETH, or about 4.98% of Ethereum's circulating supply, just short of its 5% "Alchemy of 5%" target. The company has bought ETH every week since launching its Ethereum treasury strategy in June 2025, and about 86% of its holdings are staked through its MAVAN platform, generating an estimated $245 million in annualized staking revenue. Despite a roughly 26% monthly drop in ETH, BitMine's total holdings stand at $11.1 billion, though its ETH position is about $9.6 billion underwater on cost.

title.zh: Solana反弹至76美元，较周末低点回升逾20%
title.en: Solana rebounds to $76, up over 20% from weekend low near $65

summary.zh: Solana（SOL）周一反弹至约76美元，日内一度触及78.48美元，较周六约65美元的低点回升逾20%，当时其相对强弱指数（RSI）已跌至23.5的超卖区间。美国现货SOL ETF（Spot ETF）上周净流入约440万美元，终结了此前连续六周的资金流出，其中Bitwise旗下BSOL单周吸金1,080万美元。尽管反弹强劲，SOL仍远低于92美元附近的周均线，趋势反转尚未确认。
summary.en: Solana (SOL) rebounded to about $76 on Monday, touching an intraday high of $78.48, more than 20% above Saturday's low near $65, when its daily RSI had fallen to an oversold 23.5. U.S. spot SOL ETFs took in about $4.4 million last week, ending six straight weeks of outflows, with Bitwise's BSOL alone drawing $10.8 million. The bounce remains unconfirmed as a trend reversal, with SOL still well below its weekly moving averages near $92.

title.zh: 比特币连续七周下跌，创有记录以来第二长连跌纪录
title.en: Bitcoin falls for seven straight weeks, second-longest losing streak on record

summary.zh: 比特币已连续七周收跌，为有记录以来第二长周线连跌，仅次于2022年Terra崩盘期间的九周连跌；自10月5日当周约86,500美元起，价格已累计下跌29%，周末一度跌至约55,500美元，随后反弹至61,000美元上方。市场情绪极度悲观，加密恐惧与贪婪指数（Fear and Greed Index）一度降至6，低于FTX崩盘后的水平。分析师对底部位置分歧较大，有观点认为可能下探4万美元区间，也有观点认为底部已接近形成，关键变量是美联储12月的利率决定与周三公布的核心PCE（Core PCE）通胀数据。
summary.en: Bitcoin has fallen for seven consecutive weeks, its second-longest weekly losing streak on record after the nine-week slide during the 2022 Terra collapse; the price has dropped 29% from about $86,500 in the week of October 5, touching roughly $55,500 over the weekend before recovering above $61,000. Sentiment is deeply fearful, with the Crypto Fear and Greed Index falling to 6, below its post-FTX-collapse reading. Analysts disagree on where the bottom lies, with some seeing a possible drop toward the $40,000s and others saying a bottom is forming, with the Federal Reserve's December rate decision and Wednesday's core PCE inflation data as key triggers.

title.zh: 研究警告：约4200万枚以太币面临未来量子计算攻击风险
title.en: Research warns about 42 million ETH face future quantum-computing risk

summary.zh: 匹兹堡大学（University of Pittsburgh）与安全公司SeQure的研究发现，约4,200万枚以太币（ETH），价值约720亿美元，存放在已暴露公钥（Public Key）的钱包中，未来足够强大的量子计算机理论上可据此推导出私钥（Private Key）并窃取资金；目前尚无公开已知的量子计算机具备这一能力。研究估计，若提前迁移至抗量子密钥（Quantum-Resistant Keys），445万个符合条件的钱包约需29天完成注册；若全部拖延至旧签名停用后再恢复，则需约235天。此外，61%的质押以太币（Staked ETH）在提取后也将进入已暴露公钥的钱包。以太坊开发者正在Hegotá升级（Hegotá Upgrade）中评估量子防御方案。
summary.en: Researchers at the University of Pittsburgh and security firm SeQure found that about 42 million ETH, worth roughly $72 billion, sits in wallets whose public keys have already been exposed on-chain, which a sufficiently powerful future quantum computer could theoretically use to derive private keys and steal funds; no publicly known machine can do so today. The team estimated that migrating 4.45 million eligible wallets to quantum-resistant keys could take 29 days if done early, or 235 days if all waited until after old signatures were disabled. Some 61% of staked ether is also set to move into exposed-key wallets once withdrawn. Ethereum developers are weighing quantum defenses for the planned Hegota upgrade.

title.zh: 比特币ETF单周净流出17.9亿美元，创6月以来最大
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs see $1.79 billion weekly outflow, largest since June

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）上周净流出17.9亿美元，为截至6月26日当周以来最大单周流出，也是自2024年1月产品上市以来的第三大单周流出；这已是连续第四周净流出，四周累计流出43.4亿美元，11月累计流出达41.4亿美元。贝莱德IBIT占上周流出的约76%，达13.7亿美元，周四、周五单日流出分别创该基金纪录。同期现货以太币ETF净流出3.14亿美元，连续第八周录得负值；比特币ETF总净资产已从9月中旬约1,100亿美元降至713.5亿美元。
summary.en: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.79 billion in net outflows last week, the largest weekly withdrawal since the week ended June 26 and the third-largest since the products launched in January 2024, marking a fourth consecutive week of outflows totaling $4.34 billion over the period. November outflows reached $4.14 billion, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for about 76% of the week's redemptions at $1.37 billion, including record single-day outflows on Thursday and Friday. Spot ether ETFs lost $314 million, their eighth straight week of redemptions, and total bitcoin ETF net assets have fallen from about $110 billion in mid-September to $71.35 billion.

title.zh: Kraken加元市场闪崩：比特币一度跌至1.7万美元，成交全部有效
title.en: Kraken CAD market flash crash sends bitcoin to $17,000; trades stand

summary.zh: 上周六凌晨，Kraken交易所加元（CAD）交易对的比特币价格一度跌至24,250加元（约合1.7万美元），较全球市价低近70%，原因是该交易所各法币采用独立订单簿（Order Book），加元市场流动性枯竭导致止损单连锁触发；在15分钟窗口内共成交976笔，约245枚比特币在均价低于5万加元的区间易手。Kraken表示平台订单均正常执行，未发现安全漏洞或账户被盗，所有成交维持有效；以太币、XRP及稳定币USDT的加元价格也同步暴跌。价格随后回升，周一已与全球市价重新接轨。
summary.en: Early Saturday, bitcoin briefly fell to C$24,250, about $17,000, on Kraken's Canadian dollar market, nearly 70% below global prices, after heavy selling drained liquidity from the exchange's isolated CAD order book and triggered cascading stop-loss orders; 976 trades executed in a 15-minute window, with about 245 BTC changing hands while average prices stayed below C$50,000. Kraken said every order executed correctly, no security breach or compromised accounts were found, and all trades stand, while ether, XRP and even the USDT stablecoin also plunged on the CAD book. Prices recovered within hours and were back in line with global markets by Monday.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级推迟至2027年，智能合约兼容性成主因
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade delayed to 2027 over contract compatibility

summary.zh: 以太坊核心开发者在11月19日的全体核心开发者执行层会议（All Core Devs Execution）上确认，Glamsterdam升级（Glamsterdam Upgrade）无法在原定的12月上线，最早也要到2027年1月中旬，更可能在1月底至2月初；若修改技术规范，激活时间可能延后至2027年5月。推迟主因是EIP-8037与EIP-8038两项Gas定价（Gas Pricing）提案会大幅提高合约部署与状态存储成本，可能导致现有智能合约（Smart Contract）运行失败；审计发现约200处潜在问题，以太坊基金会及安全公司已联系50多家受影响的应用团队。Hoodi测试网（Testnet）分叉暂定于12月14日当周进行，最终决定将于11月26日的开发者会议上作出。
summary.en: Ethereum core developers confirmed at their November 19 All Core Devs Execution call that the Glamsterdam upgrade cannot go live in December as planned, with mid-January 2027 the earliest possible date and late January or early February more realistic; changing the specifications could push activation to May 2027. The delay stems from gas repricing proposals EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, which would sharply raise contract deployment and state storage costs and could break existing smart contracts, with an audit flagging about 200 findings. The Ethereum Foundation and security firms have contacted more than 50 affected application teams, and a Hoodi testnet fork is tentatively planned for the week of December 14, pending a decision at the November 26 developers' meeting.

title.zh: 六名参议员致函财政部，要求州级稳定币发行方与联邦同等待遇
title.en: Six senators urge Treasury to give state stablecoin issuers equal footing

summary.zh: 六名两党参议员11月17日致函美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent），要求在《GENIUS法案》（GENIUS Act）实施细则中给予州级监管的稳定币发行方（Stablecoin Issuer）与联邦申请人同等的临时安全港（Safe Harbor）保护。联名信由参议院银行委员会数字资产小组主席Cynthia Lummis与Kirsten Gillibrand牵头，指出财政部现行提案只为待批的联邦申请人提供豁免，却未给州级发行方同等保护，可能迫使发行方转向联邦牌照，违背国会立法本意。法案允许发行量100亿美元及以下的发行方在州级监管下运营，前提是该州制度与联邦框架“基本相似”（Substantially Similar）；法案将于2027年1月18日生效。
summary.en: Six bipartisan U.S. senators wrote to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on November 17, urging the department to give state-regulated stablecoin issuers the same temporary safe harbor protection as federal applicants under the GENIUS Act's implementation rules. Led by Senate Banking digital assets subcommittee chair Cynthia Lummis and Kirsten Gillibrand, the letter said Treasury's current proposal shields only federal applicants with pending applications, with no equivalent protection for state issuers, potentially pushing firms toward federal charters against Congress's intent. The GENIUS Act allows issuers with $10 billion or less outstanding to operate under state supervision if the state's regime is "substantially similar" to the federal framework; the law takes effect January 18, 2027.

title.zh: 比特币暴跌至55,130美元后反弹重返60,000美元，27亿美元杠杆仓位被清算
title.en: Bitcoin plunges to $55,130 then rebounds above $60,000 as $2.7 billion in leverage is wiped out

summary.zh: 比特币周六一度跌至约55,130美元，创2024年9月以来新低，随后反弹重返60,000美元上方，24小时内涨幅约9%。此次暴跌触发约27亿美元杠杆仓位清算（Liquidation），创历史第11大清算事件，其中约6.5亿美元在一小时内被平仓。分析认为，美联储加息预期、美国科技股抛售及现货ETF（Spot ETF）资金流出共同施压，而杠杆出清后市场短期抛压有所缓解。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell to about $55,130 on Saturday, its lowest since September 2024, before rebounding back above $60,000 for a roughly 9% intraday gain. The drop triggered about $2.7 billion in leveraged liquidations within 24 hours, the 11th-largest liquidation event on record, with roughly $650 million wiped out in a single hour. Rate-hike expectations, a sell-off in U.S. tech stocks and spot ETF outflows pressured the market, while the flush-out of leveraged longs eased near-term selling pressure.

title.zh: 比特币ETF 11月净流出34.7亿美元，贝莱德IBIT创5.41亿美元单日流出纪录
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $3.47 billion in November as IBIT posts record $541 million outflow

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）11月以来累计净流出约34.7亿美元，全月仅有两个交易日录得净流入。贝莱德IBIT于11月19日单日净流出5.41亿美元，创该基金成立以来最大单日流出纪录；当日全市场净流出5.822亿美元。比特币ETF累计净流入已从9月23日的571.8亿美元降至11月19日的535.1亿美元，机构需求持续疲软。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded about $3.47 billion in net outflows so far in November, with only two positive sessions all month. BlackRock's IBIT posted a record $541.1 million single-day outflow on November 19, when total daily redemptions reached $582.2 million. Cumulative net inflows into the funds have fallen from $57.18 billion on September 23 to $53.51 billion on November 19, reflecting persistently weak institutional demand.

title.zh: 俄罗斯合规加密货币交易规则生效，但尚无交易所获准开市
title.en: Russia's regulated crypto trading rules take effect, but no exchange is cleared to trade yet

summary.zh: 俄罗斯央行关于有组织加密货币交易的规定于11月22日生效，获批交易所可在央行核准其交易规则后开展比特币、以太坊及USDT交易。截至目前，央行尚未公开确认任何一家交易所获得核准，莫斯科交易所计划于12月1日启动试点。普通投资者每年通过每家中介购买加密货币的上限为30万卢布（约合3,600美元），且须通过知识测试。
summary.en: Russia's rules for organized cryptocurrency trading took effect on November 22, allowing approved exchanges to offer Bitcoin, Ether and USDT once the central bank signs off on their trading rulebooks. So far the Bank of Russia has not publicly confirmed a single approval, and Moscow Exchange is targeting a December 1 pilot. Ordinary investors face a purchase cap of 300,000 rubles (about $3,600) per intermediary per year and must pass a knowledge test.

title.zh: Solana反弹至70美元附近，现货SOL ETF结束连续六周资金流出
title.en: Solana recovers toward $70 as spot SOL ETFs snap six-week outflow streak

summary.zh: SOL周末反弹至约70美元，24小时上涨约3%，但过去一个月仍下跌约33%。美国现货Solana ETF（Spot Solana ETF）当周录得约440万美元净流入，结束连续六周的资金流出，此前六周累计流出约1.974亿美元。Bitwise同期发布的估值模型预计，在乐观情形下SOL到2031年可达1,100美元。
summary.en: SOL recovered toward $70 over the weekend, up about 3% in 24 hours, though it remained down roughly 33% over the past month. U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded about $4.4 million in net inflows for the week, ending six consecutive weeks of withdrawals that had totaled roughly $197.4 million. Bitwise's valuation model published in the same week projected SOL at $1,100 by 2031 in its bullish scenario.

title.zh: 以太坊自1,538美元低点反弹至1,680美元上方，空头回补助推反弹
title.en: Ether rebounds above $1,680 from $1,538 low as short sellers fuel the bounce

summary.zh: 以太坊周日反弹至约1,685美元，较周六1,538.60美元的低点回升逾10%，但仍受阻于1,712美元附近。24小时内约8,353万美元以太期货仓位被清算，其中空头（Short）占比约76%，空头回补成为反弹的重要推手。美国现货以太坊ETF（Spot Ether ETF）当周净流出2.217亿美元，连续第五个交易日录得资金流出。
summary.en: Ether rebounded to about $1,685 on Sunday, recovering more than 10% from Saturday's low of $1,538.60, but stalled near resistance at $1,712. About $83.53 million in Ether futures positions were liquidated in 24 hours, with short positions accounting for roughly 76%, making short covering a key driver of the bounce. U.S. spot Ether ETFs recorded $221.7 million in net outflows for the week, a fifth straight day of withdrawals.

title.zh: 包装门罗币XMR1暴跌99%，疑似部署者密钥被盗致1,350万美元损失
title.en: Wrapped Monero token XMR1 collapses 99% after suspected $13.5 million deployer-key hack

summary.zh: 跨链服务Wagyu发行的包装门罗币XMR1上周五在约半小时内从约500美元暴跌至约1美元，跌幅超过99%。攻击者从XMR1部署者钱包转出520万枚代币，并向约388名买家出售约36.4万枚，套现约1,350万美元，随后将资金兑换为以太币。Wagyu创始人将事件归咎于冰岛托管商1984.hosting遭网络攻击导致部署者密钥泄露，并承诺个人赔偿受损用户；门罗币原生资产XMR未受影响。
summary.en: XMR1, the wrapped Monero token issued by cross-chain service Wagyu, collapsed more than 99% on Friday, falling from about $500 to around $1 in roughly half an hour. An attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of the deployer wallet and sold about 364,000 of them to roughly 388 buyers for $13.5 million, then converted the proceeds into Ether. Wagyu's founder blamed a breach at Icelandic hosting provider 1984.hosting for exposing the deployer key and pledged personal refunds; native Monero (XMR) was unaffected.

title.zh: IOSCO警告称抗量子升级或使区块链吞吐量下降约90%
title.en: IOSCO warns quantum-resistant upgrades could cut blockchain throughput by about 90%

summary.zh: 国际证监会组织（IOSCO）在11月19日发布的报告中警告，为抵御量子计算攻击而升级区块链可能带来显著的性能、存储与治理成本。报告指出，抗量子签名比现有椭圆曲线签名大35至40倍；Solana一条抗量子测试网在替换签名方案后吞吐量下降约90%。报告称迁移可能耗时数年，呼吁金融机构立即开始准备，尽管目前尚无量子计算机能够破解现行加密技术。
summary.en: The International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) warned in a report published on November 19 that preparing blockchains for quantum attacks could impose significant performance, storage and governance costs. Post-quantum signatures are 35 to 40 times larger than current elliptic-curve signatures, and a quantum-resistant Solana testnet saw throughput fall about 90% after switching signature schemes. Migration could take years, the report said, urging financial firms to start preparing now even though no known quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography.

title.en: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000
title.zh: 比特币自两年低点反弹9%，重回60,000美元

summary.en: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000 on November 21, recovering more than 9% from an intraday low of $55,130, its weakest level since September 2024. The sell-off wiped out about $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions over 24 hours, about $1.3 billion of it long bets, according to CoinGlass data. Trading firm QCP Capital said a lasting recovery will likely need stabilising technology stocks, calmer rates and returning institutional flows.
summary.zh: 11月21日，比特币（Bitcoin）自盘中低点55,130美元反弹逾9%，重回60,000美元上方，该低点为2024年9月以来最低。过去24小时内约18亿美元杠杆仓位被清算（Liquidation），其中约13亿美元为多头仓位（CoinGlass数据）。交易公司QCP Capital表示，持续反弹可能需要科技股企稳、利率波动缓和以及机构资金回流。

title.en: Chainflip's FLIP tanks over 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
title.zh: Chainflip疑似遭攻击损失486万美元，FLIP代币暴跌逾30%

summary.en: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip halted deposits, withdrawals, swaps and quotes on November 21 after about $4.86 million in ether and stablecoins left its Ethereum vault in a single transaction. The withdrawal carried a valid signature, pointing to a possible compromise of the aggregate key its validators use to approve payouts, and nearly all the funds were sent to mixer Tornado Cash within nine minutes. FLIP fell about 34% and the protocol said it was investigating while in full safe mode.
summary.zh: 11月21日，跨链协议Chainflip在约486万美元的以太币（Ether）与稳定币（Stablecoin）通过一笔交易流出其以太坊金库（Vault）后，暂停了存款、取款、兑换与报价。该笔提款带有有效签名，疑似验证者用于批准金库支出的聚合密钥遭到泄露，近全部资金在九分钟内被转入混币器Tornado Cash。FLIP代币下跌约34%，协议方表示正在调查并已进入全面安全模式（Safe Mode）。

title.en: Solana falls more than 75% from peak as spot SOL ETFs record $5.9 million in outflows
title.zh: Solana较历史高点跌逾75%，现货SOL ETF单日净流出590万美元

summary.en: Solana dropped to about $64.83 on November 21, nearly 78% below its January 2025 all-time high of about $293.31, and down roughly 30% in November. U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded $5.9 million in net outflows on November 20, led by Bitwise's BSOL at $4.7 million, extending a 30-day net withdrawal of $122.7 million, according to Farside Investors and CoinPerps data. The slide came despite the Alpenglow upgrade in October, which cut transaction finality to about 150 milliseconds.
summary.zh: 11月21日，Solana跌至约64.83美元，较2025年1月约293.31美元的历史高点（All-Time High）下跌近78%，11月累计跌幅约30%。美国现货Solana ETF（Spot ETF）11月20日净流出590万美元，其中Bitwise的BSOL占470万美元，过去30天累计净流出1.227亿美元（Farside Investors与CoinPerps数据）。尽管10月完成的Alpenglow升级将交易最终确认时间缩短至约150毫秒，价格仍未止跌。

title.en: Bitcoin Core fixes medium-severity node-stall bug found by Block's AI scanner
title.zh: 比特币核心修复中危节点停滞漏洞，该漏洞由Block的人工智能扫描工具发现

summary.en: Bitcoin Core disclosed CVE-2026-117348 on November 20, a medium-severity flaw that let an attacker stall a node for over a dozen seconds by repeating one orphan transaction identifier 50,000 times in a single announcement. The bug was found by an automated AI scan through Project Loupe at Spiral, Block's open-source unit, and fixed in versions 30.5 and 31.3, with version 32.1 already containing the fix. The retired 29.x branch will not receive a patch.
summary.zh: 比特币核心（Bitcoin Core）11月20日披露编号CVE-2026-117348的中危漏洞：攻击者可通过在单次公告中重复同一孤块交易（Orphan Transaction）标识符50,000次，使节点停滞十余秒。该漏洞由Block旗下开源部门Spiral的Project Loupe人工智能自动扫描发现，已在30.5与31.3版本中修复，32.1版本已包含该修复。已停止维护的29.x分支将不再获得补丁。

title.en: XRP falls to about $0.87, its lowest since November 2024, as ETF assets slip below $1 billion
title.zh: XRP跌至约0.87美元，创2024年11月以来新低，ETF资产跌破10亿美元

summary.en: XRP fell about 9% in 24 hours to around $0.87 on November 21, its lowest price since November 2024, as a broad crypto sell-off hit large-cap tokens. About $18 million in XRP futures positions were liquidated, roughly 94% of them long bets, according to CoinGlass. U.S. spot XRP ETFs recorded about $4.97 million in net outflows on Friday, taking their combined net assets to about $990 million, below the $1 billion mark.
summary.zh: 11月21日，XRP在24小时内下跌约9%至0.87美元左右，为2024年11月以来最低，加密货币整体抛售波及大市值代币。约1,800万美元XRP期货仓位被清算（Liquidation），其中约94%为多头仓位（CoinGlass数据）。美国现货XRP ETF（Spot ETF）周五净流出约497万美元，五只基金合计净资产降至约9.9亿美元，跌破10亿美元关口。

title.en: Binance hackers move $860 million in ether as bitcoin laundering surges, Elliptic says
title.zh: Elliptic称币安黑客转移8.6亿美元以太币，比特币洗钱活动激增

summary.en: Hackers linked to North Korea moved about $860 million in ether stolen from Binance between November 17 and 20, emptying five of the nine largest ether wallets tied to the October theft, according to blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. About $70 million was swapped into bitcoin through THORChain, and at least 2,310 BTC, worth about $149 million, has entered coinjoin mixing since November began, with roughly 90% of that in the past four days. Elliptic said about $2.35 billion remains in hacker-linked wallets while $2.85 billion has been frozen or seized.
summary.zh: 区块链分析公司Elliptic表示，与朝鲜有关的黑客在11月17日至20日转移了约8.6亿美元从币安盗取的以太币，清空了与10月盗窃案有关的九个最大以太币钱包中的五个。约7,000万美元通过THORChain兑换为比特币，11月以来至少2,310枚比特币（约1.49亿美元）进入混币（Coinjoin）交易，其中约90%发生在过去四天。Elliptic称约23.5亿美元仍在黑客关联钱包中，另有28.5亿美元已被冻结或扣押。

title.en: OCC gives Payoneer preliminary approval for stablecoin national trust bank
title.zh: 美国货币监理署初步批准Payoneer设立稳定币国家信托银行

summary.en: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted Payoneer preliminary conditional approval on November 20 to form PAYO Digital Bank, a national trust bank for stablecoin issuance, custody and cross-border payments. Once it receives final approval, Payoneer plans to issue PAYO-USD, a fully reserved, GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoin that will circulate only inside its platform and will not be listed on exchanges. The bank must hold at least $8 million in Tier 1 capital, and the OCC noted it has recently approved similar trust-bank charters for BitGo, Paxos, Bridge and World Liberty.
summary.zh: 美国货币监理署（OCC）11月20日给予Payoneer初步有条件批准，允许其设立PAYO Digital Bank，一家从事稳定币发行、托管与跨境支付的国家信托银行。获得最终批准后，Payoneer计划发行全额储备、符合《GENIUS法案》的稳定币PAYO-USD，该币仅在其平台内流通，不在交易所上市。该银行须持有至少800万美元一级资本（Tier 1 Capital），OCC同时指出近期已批准BitGo、Paxos、Bridge及World Liberty等类似信托银行牌照。

title.en: Spot ether ETFs log $131.2 million in outflows as redemption streak hits four sessions
title.zh: 现货以太币ETF单日净流出1.312亿美元，赎回潮延续至第四个交易日

summary.en: U.S. spot ether ETFs recorded $131.2 million in net outflows on November 19, their fourth straight session of redemptions, with BlackRock's ETHA accounting for $124.2 million, nearly 95% of the day's total. Month-to-date outflows reached about $972.6 million, close to a billion-dollar monthly drain, while ether fell to around $1,735 and tested support near $1,700. The funds have lost $208.5 million over the four sessions from November 16 to 19, according to Farside Investors data.
summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF（Spot ETF）11月19日净流出1.312亿美元，为连续第四个交易日赎回，其中贝莱德ETHA占1.242亿美元，接近当日总量的95%。11月累计净流出约9.726亿美元，接近10亿美元月度关口，以太币跌至约1,735美元并测试1,700美元附近支撑。11月16日至19日四个交易日合计净流出2.085亿美元（Farside Investors数据）。

title.en: Binance wins $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order against hackers behind record theft
title.zh: 币安获得65亿美元全球冻结令，追讨创纪录盗窃案赃款

summary.en: An Abu Dhabi court handed Binance a worldwide freezing order covering $6.5 billion, barring the hackers behind October's record theft from moving the proceeds. The order covers 18 firms that have already frozen stolen assets, and the court will consider on December 1 whether they must hand those assets over. Binance said it has already replaced the stolen assets with its own funds, while third parties have frozen or intercepted about $2.85 billion.
summary.zh: 阿布扎比法院向币安发出覆盖65亿美元的全球冻结令，禁止10月创纪录盗窃案的黑客转移赃款。该命令涉及18家已冻结被盗资产的公司，法院将于12月1日审议这些公司是否须移交资产。币安表示已用自有资金补足被盗资产，第三方已冻结或截获约28.5亿美元赃款。

summary.en: On November 20, Ether fell to $1,578.78 on Coinbase, below last weekend's $1,709 low and its lowest since July 1, down about 13% from around $1,928 a week earlier. U.S. spot Ether ETFs lost about $398.9 million in the week to November 13, their seventh consecutive weekly outflow, bringing total outflows since late September to about $2.42 billion. Separately, a wallet linked to the Binance hacker moved about 137,600 ETH, worth roughly $248 million.
summary.zh: 11月20日，以太坊（Ethereum）在Coinbase一度跌至1,578.78美元，低于上周末1,709美元的低点，为7月1日以来最低，较一周前约1,928美元下跌约13%。美国现货以太坊ETF（Spot Ether ETF）在截至11月13日的一周内净流出约3.989亿美元，为连续第七周净流出，自9月底以来累计流出约24.2亿美元。与此同时，与币安（Binance）黑客相关的钱包转移了约13.76万枚ETH，价值约2.48亿美元。

title.en: Ether drops to about $1,579, its lowest since July
title.zh: 以太坊跌至约1,579美元，创7月以来新低

summary.en: On November 20, Bitcoin fell below $59,000, erasing its entire August–September rebound and coming within about 2% of its June–July bear-market low near $57,700. A sharp sell-off in AI stocks and rising expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes drove a broad risk-off move, with Ether down about 7% and Solana and other majors down 5–6%. Roughly $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, according to CoinGlass, with long positions taking most of the losses.
summary.zh: 11月20日，比特币（Bitcoin）跌破5.9万美元，抹去了8月至9月的全部反弹，距离6月至7月约5.77万美元的熊市低点仅约2%。AI概念股大跌与美联储（Federal Reserve）进一步加息预期引发全市场抛售，以太坊（Ethereum）跌约7%，Solana（SOL）等主流币跌5%至6%。过去24小时，全网杠杆仓位清算约15亿美元（CoinGlass数据），其中多头占绝大多数。

title.en: Bitcoin falls below $59,000, nearing its 2026 bear-market low
title.zh: 比特币跌破5.9万美元，逼近2026年熊市低点

summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $582.2 million in net outflows on November 19, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $541.1 million — its largest single-day outflow since launch. November outflows have now approached $3.5 billion, and Bitcoin has fallen more than 20% this month, from around $81,000 at the start of November to below $60,000. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped into "Extreme Fear" territory.
summary.zh: 11月19日，美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）单日净流出5.822亿美元，其中贝莱德（BlackRock）旗下IBIT流出5.411亿美元，创该基金成立以来最大单日流出。11月以来，比特币ETF累计净流出已接近35亿美元，比特币11月跌幅超过20%，从月初约8.1万美元跌至6万美元下方。加密货币恐惧与贪婪指数（Crypto Fear & Greed Index）跌入“极度恐惧”区间。

title.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs see $582 million in daily outflows; BlackRock's IBIT posts record redemption
title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF单日净流出5.82亿美元，贝莱德IBIT创最大单日赎回

summary.en: Hardware wallet maker Ledger confirmed on November 18 that tampered devices have been found in Berlin and that it is investigating two suspected units in Dubai, calling it the "same incident" as the earlier Southeast Asia case. Every confirmed device carries a physical modification designed to capture the recovery phrase during setup; Ledger stressed there is no flaw in its secure chip or operating system and no confirmed case involving a device bought on ledger.com. Ledger urged anyone who bought a device in Berlin since January to contact support and is offering X-ray inspections at its factory in France. On-chain analytics firm Bitquery traced about $1.68 million stolen from 16 wallets on November 14–16.
summary.zh: 硬件钱包制造商Ledger于11月18日确认，在柏林发现了被物理篡改的设备，并正在调查迪拜的两台可疑设备，称与此前东南亚事件属于“同一事件”。所有已确认设备均带有用于在设置过程中窃取助记词（Recovery Phrase）的改装部件；Ledger强调其安全芯片与操作系统没有漏洞，且没有已确认案例涉及通过官网ledger.com购买的设备。Ledger敦促今年以来在柏林购买过设备的用户联系客服，并为可疑设备提供在法国工厂的X光检测。链上分析机构Bitquery追踪到11月14日至16日有约168万美元从16个钱包被盗。

title.en: Ledger confirms tampered hardware wallets in Berlin as probe expands to Dubai
title.zh: Ledger确认柏林出现篡改硬件钱包，调查扩大至迪拜

summary.en: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Michael Selig said at the November 19 Capitol Crypto Forum that onchain derivatives venues such as Hyperliquid could offer perpetual futures to U.S. retail traders only by registering as an exchange or partnering with a licensed one, with no special exemptions for operating onchain. Selig pointed to Backpack, which secured three U.S. derivatives licenses this week, as an example of the compliant route for crypto-native firms, and said federal oversight could keep trading onshore rather than pushing it abroad. Hyperliquid itself remains unavailable to U.S. customers.
summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）主席Michael Selig在11月19日的国会加密论坛上表示，Hyperliquid等链上衍生品平台若想面向美国散户提供永续合约（Perpetual Futures），须自行取得交易所注册或与已持牌交易所合作，链上运营不享有特殊豁免。Selig以本周获得三项美国衍生品牌照的Backpack为例，说明加密原生公司可走合规路径进入美国市场；他同时表示，联邦监管有助于把交易留在美国境内，而非推向海外。Hyperliquid本身目前仍不对美国用户开放。

title.en: CFTC chair: no special exemptions for onchain trading; Hyperliquid could enter the U.S. via licensed routes
title.zh: CFTC主席：链上交易平台无特殊豁免，Hyperliquid可通过持牌路径进入美国

summary.en: VanEck has notified Gemini that it is ending custody and clearing agreements for its U.S. spot Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs (HODL, ETHV and VSOL), with the agreements terminating on or about February 16, 2027; Coinbase Custody will continue as custodian for all three funds. The three Form 8-K filings, signed November 19, gave no reason for the change. The Solana fund's termination also ends a Gemini staking addendum, with no replacement arrangement disclosed.
summary.zh: VanEck已通知Gemini，终止其美国比特币（Bitcoin）、以太坊（Ethereum）与Solana现货ETF（HODL、ETHV、VSOL）的托管与清算协议，相关协议将于2027年2月16日左右到期，Coinbase Custody将继续担任三只基金的托管方。三份8-K文件于11月19日签署，未说明终止原因。Solana基金的终止还涉及Gemini提供的质押（Staking）服务附加协议，其替代安排尚未公布。

title.en: VanEck ends Gemini as custodian for its Bitcoin, Ether and Solana ETFs; Coinbase stays on
title.zh: VanEck终止Gemini作为三只加密ETF的托管方，Coinbase继续担任托管

summary.en: On November 19, the U.S. Senate Banking Committee questioned President Trump's SEC nominees, Democrat Kristin Johnson and Republican Steven Levine, on tokenization policy, regulatory exemptions and prediction markets. Johnson argued tokenization policy should go through formal rulemaking rather than rely on the existing innovation exemption, while Levine described the exemption as narrow and time-limited. The two CFTC nominees were questioned earlier by the Senate Agriculture Committee on prediction markets and state jurisdiction disputes. Seven of the ten commissioner seats across the SEC and CFTC are currently vacant.
summary.zh: 11月19日，美国参议院银行委员会（Senate Banking Committee）就特朗普提名的SEC委员人选举行听证会，民主党提名人Kristin Johnson与共和党提名人Steven Levine就代币化（Tokenization）政策、监管豁免及预测市场等问题接受质询。Johnson主张代币化政策应通过正式规则制定程序，而非依赖现有的创新豁免；Levine则称该豁免范围窄且有时限。两名CFTC提名人此前也在参议院农业委员会接受了质询，议题包括预测市场与各州的管辖权争议。目前SEC与CFTC合计10个委员席位中有7个空缺。

title.en: U.S. Senate questions SEC nominees on tokenization policy and prediction markets
title.zh: 美国参议院质询SEC提名人，代币化政策与预测市场成焦点

summary.en: On November 19, tokenization platform Securitize announced that shares of AI company Anthropic are available on Solana through its Securitize Stocks platform, on Anthropic's first day of trading on Nasdaq; the stock opened at $111.50, 34% above its $83 IPO price, and closed at $97.17. The product offers tokenized security entitlements backed 1:1 by underlying shares to eligible investors, settling in USDC with liquidity support from Jump Trading. Amgen and Fox Corporation joined the same day, taking the platform's tokenized U.S. equities past 50.
summary.zh: 11月19日，代币化平台Securitize宣布，人工智能（AI）公司Anthropic的股票已通过其Securitize Stocks平台在Solana上线，恰逢Anthropic在纳斯达克（Nasdaq）首日交易；其股价开盘111.50美元，较83美元的发行价高出34%，收于97.17美元。该产品为与标的股票1:1挂钩的证券权益凭证（Security Entitlements），面向符合条件的投资者，交易以USDC结算，由Jump Trading提供流动性支持。同期上线的还有安进（Amgen）与福克斯（Fox），平台代币化美股总数超过50只。

title.en: Securitize tokenizes Anthropic shares on Solana on the AI firm's first day of public trading
title.zh: Securitize在Anthropic上市首日将其股票代币化并上线Solana

summary.en: At the November 19 All Core Developers meeting, Ethereum developers discussed the Glamsterdam upgrade timeline: mainnet activation could come as early as mid-January 2027 under the current specifications, but revising gas-pricing proposals EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 could push it to April or May 2027. Security firm ChainSecurity found about 200 compatibility issues affecting at least 50 companies' contracts, including three high-severity cases. Developers tentatively proposed a Hoodi testnet rehearsal in the week of December 14, with a final decision due at the November 26 meeting.
summary.zh: 在11月19日的核心开发者会议（All Core Developers）上，以太坊开发者讨论了Glamsterdam升级的时间表：若保留现有规范，主网最早可于2027年1月中旬激活；若修改EIP-8037与EIP-8038两项Gas定价提案，激活可能推迟至2027年4月或5月。安全公司ChainSecurity发现约200处兼容性问题，涉及至少50家公司的合约，其中3项为高严重性。开发者暂定于12月14日当周在Hoodi测试网（Testnet）进行演练，最终决定将于11月26日的会议上作出。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over smart contract compatibility
title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级或推迟至2027年5月，智能合约兼容性成关键

summary.en: At the Breakpoint 2026 conference in London, Anza, Solana's core development firm, unveiled a 2027 technical roadmap: network compute capacity is targeted to double from about 250 million to 500 million compute units per second, while the compute cost of token-account transactions would fall by about 80% and the per-transaction account limit would rise from 64 to 96. The plan also includes on-chain vector processing to run AI models fully on-chain, and Rotor to replace the Turbine block-propagation mechanism. These are targets for the end of 2027, not yet live on mainnet.
summary.zh: 在伦敦Breakpoint 2026大会上，Solana核心开发公司Anza公布了2027年技术路线图：网络算力目标从约2.5亿计算单元/秒（Compute Units per Second）提升至5亿，代币账户交易的计算成本降低约80%，单笔交易可触及的账户上限从64个提高至96个。路线图还包括链上向量处理（Vector Processing）以支持AI模型完全在链上运行，以及以Rotor替代区块传播机制Turbine。上述目标均为2027年底前的规划，尚未上线主网（Mainnet）。

title.en: Anza unveils Solana's 2027 roadmap: double compute capacity, 80% cheaper token transactions
title.zh: Anza发布Solana 2027年路线图：算力翻倍，代币账户成本降80%
比特币逼近6万美元关口，2026年现货ETF累计净流出突破25亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin approaches $60,000 as 2026 spot ETF outflows top $2.5 billion

summary.zh: 11月19日，比特币（Bitcoin）跌至61,635美元，逼近6万美元心理关口，以太坊（Ethereum）与Solana（SOL）同步下跌约1.6%。美联储（Federal Reserve）会议纪要强化了进一步加息预期，加之美股全线下挫，令风险资产承压。美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）周三再录得超3亿美元净流出，2026年累计净流出突破25亿美元，基金总资产降至三个月低点；加密货币恐惧与贪婪指数（Crypto Fear & Greed Index）跌至10，进入“极度恐惧”区间。
summary.en: On November 19, Bitcoin fell to $61,635, edging toward the psychologically important $60,000 level, while Ethereum and Solana each dropped about 1.6%. Minutes from the Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of further rate hikes, and a broad Wall Street sell-off weighed on risk assets. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded more than $300 million in net outflows on Wednesday, pushing 2026 cumulative net outflows past $2.5 billion and total fund assets to a three-month low, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 10, in "Extreme Fear" territory.

title.zh: SEC指控8家公司通过假投顾与假交易平台骗取投资者逾3,700万美元
title.en: SEC charges eight firms over $37 million fake adviser and crypto platform scam

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）11月19日指控8家科罗拉多州实体通过假投资顾问（Investment Adviser）与假加密资产交易平台骗取美国投资者逾3,700万美元，受害者超过1,500人。涉案方通过社交媒体广告将投资者引入群聊，先以美股交易建议取得信任，再诱使其向虚假平台汇款；为装作合法，他们还伪造SEC证书并利用真实监管备案文件背书。该骗局自2024年8月至2026年5月以四组“投顾—平台”搭档轮换运作，SEC正寻求禁令、非法所得返还及民事处罚。
summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on November 19 charged eight Colorado-based entities with using fake investment advisers and sham crypto trading platforms to take more than $37 million from over 1,500 U.S. investors. The defendants lured victims through social media ads into group chats, won trust with U.S. stock tips, then directed them to send funds to fake platforms, bolstering the ruse with forged SEC certificates and real regulatory filings. The scheme ran from August 2024 to May 2026 in four rotating "adviser-platform" pairs, and the SEC is seeking injunctions, disgorgement and civil penalties.

title.zh: Sky旗下USDS稳定币市值缩水逾30%，15亿美元USDC撤出储备
title.en: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks over 30% as $1.5 billion in USDC exits reserves

summary.zh: 在区块链分析公司Inca Digital发布调查报告后，Sky协议的USDS稳定币（Stablecoin）市值单日缩水逾30%至32亿美元，超15亿美元USDC撤出其锚定稳定模块（Peg Stability Module，PSM）。报告称，过去数年有5.18亿美元与黑客、受制裁实体等非法行为相关的交易经由PSM流转，其中逾1亿美元与朝鲜行为体有关，包括2025年Bybit被盗案资金。尽管USDS维持1美元锚定，治理代币SKY单日重挫约26%；Sky方面强调涉案交易仅占PSM累计交易量的约0.03%，协议仍超额抵押、运转正常。
summary.en: Sky's USDS stablecoin lost more than 30% of its market capitalization to $3.2 billion in a day after blockchain analytics firm Inca Digital published an investigation into illicit-linked transactions through its Peg Stability Module (PSM), with over $1.5 billion in USDC withdrawn from the facility. The report identified $518 million in transactions over several years involving wallets linked to hackers and sanctioned entities, including more than $100 million tied to North Korean actors and funds from the February 2025 Bybit hack. USDS held its $1 peg, but governance token SKY fell about 26% in a day; Sky said the flagged activity was roughly 0.03% of the PSM's cumulative volume and that the protocol remains overcollateralized.

title.zh: SEC民主党提名人：代币化股票政策应走正式规则制定程序
title.en: Democratic SEC nominee says tokenization policy deserves full rulemaking

summary.zh: 美国参议院银行委员会（Senate Banking Committee）11月19日就特朗普提名的两位SEC委员人选举行确认听证会，民主党提名人Kristin Johnson表示，SEC应将代币化股票（Tokenized Stocks）的“创新豁免”改为经过公众评议的正式规则。已有60多家上市公司反对第三方在未经发行人同意的情况下将其股票代币化，认为豁免程序绕过了公众评议。共和党提名人Steven Levine则认为豁免范围有限且有时限，可作为正式规则出台前的过渡安排。
summary.en: At a Senate Banking Committee confirmation hearing on November 19, Democratic SEC nominee Kristin Johnson said the agency should revisit its tokenization "innovation exemption" through formal rulemaking with a public comment period. More than 60 public companies have objected to third parties tokenizing their shares without issuer consent, arguing the exemption bypassed public comment. Republican nominee Steven Levine countered that the exemption is narrow and time-limited, serving as a bridge toward a durable rule.

title.zh: 特朗普媒体拟在不抛售比特币的情况下偿还8.84亿美元债务
title.en: Trump Media aims to clear $884 million in debt without selling its bitcoin

summary.zh: 特朗普媒体科技集团（Trump Media & Technology Group）正设法在11月30日回售日前处理最高8.835亿美元的可转换票据（Convertible Notes）现金偿付要求，而不抛售其比特币（Bitcoin）持仓或增发股份。该公司已用现金折价回购1亿美元票据，截至9月30日持有约15,649枚比特币，同期现金及短期投资约3.93亿美元。公司警告称，若其他融资不足，仍可能需要出售比特币或其他数字资产来完成偿付。
summary.en: Trump Media & Technology Group is working to address up to $883.5 million in potential cash repayment demands on its convertible notes on November 30 without selling its bitcoin holdings or issuing additional shares. The company has already repurchased $100 million of the notes at a discount using cash on hand; as of September 30 it held about 15,649 BTC alongside roughly $393 million in cash and short-term investments. It warned it may still need to sell bitcoin or other digital assets if other financing falls short.

title.zh: Roundhill撤回Solana与XRP收益型ETF申请，同类产品规模仅约1,200万美元
title.en: Roundhill scraps Solana and XRP income ETFs as rival funds hold just $12 million

summary.zh: 资产管理公司Roundhill已向SEC申请撤回其Solana与XRP备兑看涨（Covered Call）策略ETF的注册文件，结束了一年多的反复延期，且未说明原因。尽管美国现货Solana与XRP ETF在5月至10月合计吸引9.69亿美元净流入，收益型同类产品需求却十分冷淡：竞争对手Amplify的两只收益型基金合计规模仅约1,230万美元，不到现货基金规模的0.4%。Roundhill同日还撤回了一只杠杆型ETF的申请，显示此次调整或是更广泛的产品线梳理。
summary.en: Asset manager Roundhill has asked the SEC to withdraw its proposed Solana and XRP covered-call strategy ETFs, ending more than a year of repeated delays without giving a reason. Although U.S. spot Solana and XRP ETFs drew a combined $969 million in net inflows from May through October, demand for income products has been weak: rival Amplify's two income funds held a combined $12.3 million, less than 0.4% of spot funds tracking the same tokens. Roundhill also withdrew a leveraged ETF proposal the same day, suggesting a broader product review.

title.zh: K3 Capital的sBOLD金库8分钟内被盗340万美元，区块构建者分走大头
title.en: K3 Capital's sBOLD vault drained of $3.4 million in eight minutes; block builders took the largest share

summary.zh: K3 Capital旗下以太坊（Ethereum）储蓄产品sBOLD的金库（Vault）11月18日在约8分钟内被盗约340万美元，攻击者利用份额定价的会计漏洞，以虚高价格赎回份额。链上分析显示，一个复制攻击的套利机器人（Bot）提取了191万美元，其中约178万美元作为最大可提取价值（Maximal Extractable Value，MEV）费用支付给了以太坊区块构建者（Block Builders），原始攻击者仅保留约52万美元。审计机构ChainSecurity曾在2025年5月指出类似漏洞并称已修复，目前尚不清楚此次攻击是否利用了同一问题。
summary.en: K3 Capital's sBOLD savings vault on Ethereum was drained of about $3.4 million in roughly eight minutes on November 18, after attackers exploited an accounting flaw in how the vault priced its shares to redeem them at inflated values. On-chain analysis shows a copycat arbitrage bot extracted $1.91 million, paying about $1.78 million of it to Ethereum block builders as maximal extractable value (MEV) fees to prioritize its transactions, while the original attacker kept only about $520,000. Auditor ChainSecurity had flagged a similar vulnerability in May 2025 and said it was mitigated; it remains unclear whether this attack used the same issue.

title.zh: 代币化Anthropic股票登陆BNB链，币安5亿美元IPO认购额度数小时内售罄
title.en: Tokenized Anthropic goes live on BNB Chain as Binance's $500 million IPO campaign fills within hours

summary.zh: 币安创始人赵长鹏宣布，与Anthropic股票挂钩的代币将于11月19日公司纳斯达克上市（Nasdaq）首日登陆BNB链，发行方包括bStocks、Ondo与xStocks。Anthropic以每股83美元定价IPO，募资约813.4亿美元；币安钱包（Binance Wallet）此前推出的5亿美元pre-IPO认购活动在数小时内达到上限，但参与并不保证获得配额。需要注意的是，这些代币仅提供股价敞口，并非直接持有Anthropic股票，不附带投票权与分红权，币安也不独立核实其储备资产。
summary.en: Binance founder Changpeng "CZ" Zhao said tokens linked to Anthropic shares will go live on BNB Chain on November 19, the day of the company's Nasdaq debut under the ticker ANT, via bStocks, Ondo and xStocks. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, raising about $81.34 billion, while Binance Wallet's $500 million pre-IPO subscription campaign filled its cap within hours — though participation did not guarantee an allocation. The tokens offer exposure to the share price rather than direct ownership, carrying no voting or dividend rights, and Binance says it does not independently verify the reserves backing them.

title.zh: Pump.fun加速抛售SOL手续费收入，5天内两次向Kraken转入近千万美元
title.en: Pump.fun accelerates SOL fee sales with two Kraken transfers in five days

summary.zh: 据链上分析师监测，Solana生态迷因币发行平台Pump.fun近期加快了出售SOL手续费收入的频率：5天前向Kraken转入64,666枚SOL（约519万美元），11月19日又转入33,390枚SOL（约243万美元），间隔从以往约两周缩短至5天。自2024年初以来，Pump.fun已累计出售约572.6万枚SOL，套现约9.01亿美元，平均售价约157.3美元。需要说明的是，转入交易所并不等同于已完成出售。
summary.en: Solana memecoin launchpad Pump.fun has accelerated sales of its SOL fee revenue, on-chain analysts report: it moved 64,666 SOL (about $5.19 million) to Kraken five days ago and another 33,390 SOL (about $2.43 million) on November 19, shortening the interval between transfers from roughly two weeks to five days. Since early 2024, Pump.fun has cumulatively sold about 5.726 million SOL for roughly $901 million at an average price of about $157.3. A transfer to an exchange does not necessarily mean the tokens have been sold.

title.zh: 比特币短暂跌破6.3万美元，以太坊与Solana同步走低，市场抛售延续
title.en: Bitcoin briefly slips below $63,000 as Ethereum and Solana fall with it

summary.zh: 11月18日，加密货币市场延续抛售，比特币（Bitcoin）一度跌破6.3万美元，截至美东傍晚报62,387美元，日内下跌3.8%；以太坊（Ethereum）跌至1,753美元，Solana（SOL）跌至72.94美元。流动性收紧、国债收益率居高不下以及市场等待美联储（Federal Reserve）10月会议纪要，令风险偏好持续承压；比特币上周下跌12.6%后已跌破200周移动平均线（200-week moving average），该长期支撑位目前约在6.8万美元附近。
summary.en: Crypto markets extended their sell-off on November 18, with Bitcoin briefly slipping below $63,000 and closing the U.S. evening near $62,387, down 3.8% on the day. Ethereum fell to $1,753 and Solana to $72.94 as tightening liquidity, elevated Treasury yields and uncertainty ahead of the Federal Reserve's October meeting minutes weighed on risk appetite. Bitcoin has also fallen below its 200-week moving average, a long-term support level now near $68,000, after a 12.6% drop last week.

title.zh: CoinShares清仓全部以太坊持仓，套现1,660万美元用于股票回购
title.en: CoinShares sells its entire Ethereum treasury to fund a share buyback

summary.zh: 加密资产管理公司CoinShares在11月18日公布的三季度财报中披露，已出售全部公司以太坊（Ethereum）持仓，价值1,660万美元，同时出售一半Solana（SOL）持仓，价值270万美元，共套现1,930万美元，用于支持最高4,000万美元的股票回购（share buyback）计划。公司股价当日上涨13%；三季度净利润3,958万美元，同比增长27%，但收入同比下降近45%至2,769万美元。
summary.en: Crypto asset manager CoinShares disclosed in its third-quarter results on November 18 that it has sold its entire corporate Ethereum holding, worth $16.6 million, along with half of its Solana position, worth $2.7 million. The $19.3 million raised will help fund a share buyback of up to $40 million. Shares rose 13% on the day; quarterly net profit was $39.6 million, up 27% year over year, while revenue fell almost 45% to $27.7 million.

title.zh: Curve披露3.82万美元手续费合约漏洞，治理投票决定是否更换合约
title.en: Curve discloses $38,200 fee-contract exploit as governance votes on a replacement

summary.zh: 去中心化金融（DeFi）协议Curve Finance披露，攻击者11月10日利用其CowSwapBurner手续费转换合约的签名验证漏洞，通过138笔伪造交易盗走约3.82万美元的DAO手续费收入。Curve表示用户存款、借贷市场和crvUSD稳定币均未受影响，紧急DAO（Emergency DAO）已暂停以太坊（Ethereum）上的手续费转换；一项以递减式拍卖（descending-price auction）机制替换该合约的治理提案正在投票，将于11月20日结束。
summary.en: DeFi protocol Curve Finance disclosed that an attacker stole about $38,200 in DAO fee revenue on November 10 by exploiting a signature-validation flaw in its CowSwapBurner fee-conversion contract, executing 138 forged trades. Curve said user deposits, lending markets and its crvUSD stablecoin were unaffected, and its Emergency DAO has paused fee conversion on Ethereum. A governance proposal to replace the contract with a descending-price auction mechanism is open for voting until November 20.

title.zh: 英伟达季度营收创纪录1,158亿美元，董事会明确不恢复黄仁勋职务
title.en: Nvidia posts record $115.8 billion quarter as board rules out Huang's return

summary.zh: 英伟达（Nvidia）公布季度营收1,158亿美元，同比增长103%，超出市场预期，数据中心（data center）业务收入达1,076亿美元；公司预计下季度营收约1,300亿美元，同样高于预期。董事会主席确认董事会无意恢复已辞职的黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）的首席执行官职务，消除了过去一周拖累AI股与比特币（Bitcoin）的领导层不确定性；英伟达股价在盘后交易中上涨约3%。
summary.en: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and above expectations, with data center revenue of $107.6 billion. The company forecast about $130 billion in revenue for the current quarter, also above estimates. Board chair Harvey Jones confirmed the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO, removing the leadership uncertainty that had weighed on AI stocks and Bitcoin over the past week; shares rose about 3% in after-hours trading.

title.zh: Solana现货ETF终结24天无流入纪录，单日净流入约1,170万美元
title.en: Solana spot ETFs snap 24-day inflow drought with about $11.7 million

summary.zh: 美国现货Solana（SOL）ETF录得约1,170万美元净流入，终结连续24个交易日无流入的纪录，其中Bitwise的Solana质押ETF（BSOL）吸纳约1,080万美元。不同数据来源对流入日期的记录存在差异：独立资金流追踪机构将这笔流入计入11月16日交易日，并显示11月17日净流入为零；自推出以来，这些ETF累计净流入约14.2亿美元。
summary.en: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded about $11.7 million in net inflows, ending a 24-day stretch without a daily inflow. Bitwise's Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) drew about $10.8 million of the total. Flow trackers differ on the date, with independent trackers attributing the inflow to the November 16 session and reporting zero net flows on November 17. The funds have gathered roughly $1.42 billion in cumulative net inflows since launch.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF单日净流出2.4亿美元，贝莱德IBIT占近九成
title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $240 million as IBIT leads outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币（Bitcoin）ETF在11月17日录得约2.4亿美元净流出，此前一日曾短暂净流入790万美元；贝莱德（BlackRock）的IBIT流出约2.095亿美元，占当日流出总额的近九成。现货以太坊（Ethereum）ETF同日净流出约2,900万美元，为连续第三个交易日流出；CryptoQuant表示比特币已重回看跌阶段，其分析师共识指数（Analyst Consensus Index）处于去年11月以来最悲观水平。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $240 million in net outflows on November 17, reversing a modest $7.9 million inflow the previous day. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for about $209.5 million of the outflows. Spot Ethereum ETFs lost about $29 million the same day, a third straight session of redemptions. CryptoQuant said Bitcoin has returned to a bearish phase, with its Analyst Consensus Index at its most bearish since November 2025.

title.zh: 美法官裁定MEV套利不构成电汇欺诈，2,500万美元以太坊案件无罪结案
title.en: U.S. judge acquits brothers in $25 million Ethereum MEV case

summary.zh: 美国纽约曼哈顿联邦法官杰西卡·克拉克（Jessica Clarke）裁定，Anton与James Peraire-Bueno兄弟在2023年4月通过诱饵交易与中继软件漏洞、12秒内从以太坊（Ethereum）交易机器人手中获取约2,500万美元的行为不构成电汇欺诈（wire fraud），检方未能证明存在实质性虚假陈述。法官指出以太坊是“没有使用条款的无信任、高度对抗性环境”，此案为美国首起针对最大可提取价值（MEV）操作的刑事起诉；2025年11月首次审理曾因陪审团僵持而流审。
summary.en: U.S. District Judge Jessica Clarke in Manhattan acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of fraud and money-laundering conspiracy charges over a $25 million Ethereum trading scheme, ruling prosecutors had not established the material misrepresentation wire fraud requires. The brothers used bait transactions and a relay software flaw in April 2023 to take about $25 million from trading bots in 12 seconds. Clarke described Ethereum as a trustless, highly adversarial environment with no terms of use; the case was the first U.S. criminal prosecution over a so-called MEV exploit, after a first trial ended in a mistrial in November 2025.

title.zh: CLARITY法案仍陷僵局，参议院转向SEC与CFTC提名人确认
title.en: CLARITY Act stalls as Senate turns to SEC and CFTC confirmations

summary.zh: 美国《数字资产市场清晰法案》（CLARITY Act）在参议院仍处于停滞状态，该法案9月15日以49比50未能通过终结辩论程序，距所需的60票还差11票；随着民主党将于2027年1月3日接管国会两院，本届国会剩余时间已不多。参议院目前将重点转向监管人事确认：特朗普总统11月12日提名了四名SEC与CFTC委员，参议院银行委员会定于11月19日上午10点就SEC提名人举行听证会。
summary.en: The U.S. Digital Asset Market Clarity Act remains stalled in the Senate after a September 15 motion to end debate failed 49-50, eleven votes short of the 60 needed, with little time left before Democrats take control of both chambers on January 3, 2027. Attention has shifted to regulator confirmations: President Trump nominated four SEC and CFTC commissioners on November 12, and the Senate Banking Committee has scheduled a hearing for the two SEC nominees on November 19 at 10 a.m. Eastern.

title.zh: Kalshi在CFTC命令下暂停特朗普演讲相关押注，预测市场面临内幕交易审查
title.en: Kalshi halts Trump speech bets after CFTC order as prediction markets face insider-trading scrutiny

summary.zh: 预测市场平台Kalshi已暂停特朗普总统公开讲话中是否提及特定词汇的押注，此前美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）上周要求其终止这类“提及市场”（mention markets）。CFTC此前已对这类市场展开调查，因白宫一名提词员曾利用提前知晓的讲稿信息进行交易并被处以罚款；Kalshi表示不同意该决定。体育类提及市场此前已被下架，这类市场每月交易量曾达约9000万美元。
summary.en: Prediction-market platform Kalshi has suspended bets on whether President Donald Trump will mention specific words in his speeches, after the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) ordered the contracts halted last week. The CFTC has been scrutinising the "mention markets" over insider-trading risks, after a White House teleprompter operator was found to have traded on advance knowledge of the president's remarks. Sports mention markets were already removed, and the affected markets previously generated about $90 million in monthly trading volume.

title.zh: Coinbase借贷产品Coinbase Borrow登陆纽约，借Morpho完成全美50州布局
title.en: Coinbase Borrow reaches New York via Morpho, completing its rollout across all 50 U.S. states

summary.zh: Coinbase宣布其链上借贷产品Coinbase Borrow已向纽约居民开放，在获得纽约州金融服务局（NYDFS）批准后完成全美50州布局。纽约用户可抵押比特币（Bitcoin）、以太币（Ether）或Solana借入USDC，额度上限分别为500万、100万和10万美元，借贷通过Morpho协议在Base网络上执行。该产品自2025年1月推出以来已发放逾34亿美元贷款，目前未偿余额逾17亿美元。
summary.en: Coinbase has opened its onchain lending product Coinbase Borrow to New York residents, completing its rollout across all 50 U.S. states after approval from the New York State Department of Financial Services (NYDFS). New York users can borrow USDC against Bitcoin, Ether or Solana, with limits of up to $5 million, $1 million and $100,000 respectively, with lending executed through the Morpho protocol on Base. The product has originated more than $3.4 billion in loans since its January 2025 launch, with over $1.7 billion outstanding.

title.zh: Anchorage与Kalshi Prime合作，机构可用托管的比特币作保证金交易
title.en: Anchorage and Kalshi Prime let institutions post custodied Bitcoin as trading margin

summary.zh: Anchorage Digital与Kalshi Prime宣布合作，机构客户可将存放在Anchorage Digital Bank托管的比特币（Bitcoin）与稳定币（stablecoins）作为保证金，在Kalshi Prime的HODL Margining网络上交易，无需划转或出售资产。该安排采用三方模式，Anchorage负责托管并锁定质押资产，Kalshi Prime将其认可为保证金，依托Anchorage的Atlas平台运行。这是Kalshi Prime继BitGo之后的第二个托管方合作。
summary.en: Anchorage Digital has partnered with Kalshi Prime to let institutional clients use Bitcoin and stablecoins held in custody at Anchorage Digital Bank as margin on Kalshi Prime's HODL Margining network, without transferring or selling the assets. The tri-party arrangement sees Anchorage retain custody and lock the pledged collateral while Kalshi Prime recognises it as margin, running on Anchorage's Atlas platform. It is Kalshi Prime's second custodian integration for HODL Margining, after BitGo.

title.zh: CFTC批准Backpack与tZERO运营区块链衍生品交易所及清算所
title.en: CFTC approves Backpack and tZERO to run blockchain-based derivatives exchanges and clearinghouses

summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）已批准Backpack与tZERO运营基于区块链技术的受监管衍生品交易所和清算所，两家公司均获得指定合约市场（DCM）与衍生品清算组织（DCO）牌照。Backpack计划向美国用户提供24小时杠杆加密货币永续合约（perpetual futures）交易；tZERO则将其牌照纳入面向机构的基础设施服务。CFTC主席Michael Selig称，此举为新一代区块链市场基础设施建立了受监管路径。
summary.en: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved Backpack and tZERO to operate regulated derivatives exchanges and clearinghouses built on blockchain technology, with both firms holding designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO) registrations. Backpack plans to offer U.S. users 24/7 leveraged crypto perpetual futures, while tZERO will fold its licences into an infrastructure service for institutions. CFTC Chair Michael Selig called the approvals a regulated pathway for a new generation of blockchain-based market infrastructure.

title.zh: 意大利最大银行Intesa三季度减持比特币与以太坊ETF，加仓Solana与XRP
title.en: Italy's Intesa Sanpaolo cuts Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF stakes, adds Solana and XRP in Q3

summary.zh: 意大利最大银行集团Intesa Sanpaolo在三季度大幅调整加密货币ETF持仓：其ARK 21Shares比特币ETF（Bitcoin ETF）持仓减少42.9%，贝莱德以太坊质押ETF（Ethereum Staking ETF）持仓减少56.6%；同时新建约1414万美元的Bitwise Solana质押ETF仓位，并将XRP相关持仓增至2721万美元。披露的加密货币ETF总持仓升至1.0856亿美元，季度增长约19.5%，比特币仍是其最大敞口。
summary.en: Italy's largest banking group, Intesa Sanpaolo, sharply reshuffled its crypto ETF holdings in the third quarter, cutting its ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF stake by 42.9% and its BlackRock Ethereum staking ETF position by 56.6%, according to its SEC Form 13F filing. It opened a roughly $14.14 million position in the Bitwise Solana Staking ETF and raised its XRP exposure to $27.21 million. Total disclosed crypto ETF holdings rose about 19.5% on the quarter to $108.56 million, with Bitcoin remaining its largest exposure.

title.zh: Wintermute警告比特币或跌入5万美元区间，称熊市尚未结束
title.en: Wintermute warns Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s, saying the bear market is not over

summary.zh: 加密货币做市商Wintermute表示，比特币（Bitcoin）跌破约6.8万美元的200周均线后，跌势可能尚未结束，预计将承压下探5万美元区间，周末约6.2万美元的低点是首个关键位置。推动因素包括市场对美联储12月加息的预期升温、现货比特币ETF（Spot ETF）今年以来约19亿美元的净流出，以及稳定币供应收缩。Wintermute称，只有比特币收复6.8万美元并伴随ETF资金回流，才会转趋谨慎乐观。
summary.en: Crypto market maker Wintermute has warned that Bitcoin's slide may not be over after it broke below its 200-week moving average near $68,000, with pressure expected into the $50,000s and the weekend low near $62,000 as the first level to watch. The firm pointed to rising expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December, about $1.9 billion in net outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs so far in 2026, and shrinking stablecoin supply. Wintermute said it would turn less cautious only if Bitcoin closes back above $68,000 with ETF inflows on the same day.

title.zh: 比特币在6.5万美元附近徘徊，期权交易员加大下行保护
title.en: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 as options traders seek downside protection

summary.zh: 比特币（Bitcoin）周二在约6.49万美元附近交易，周跌幅约12.7%，市场等待英伟达财报与美联储11月18日公布的会议纪要。期权市场情绪转趋防御：Deribit上行权价6万美元的看跌期权（put）以约9亿美元未平仓合约成为最大持仓，超过10万美元看涨期权。美国现货比特币ETF（Spot ETF）上周净流出约10.7亿美元，为连续第三周资金外流。
summary.en: Bitcoin traded near $64,900 on Tuesday, down about 12.7% on the week, as markets awaited Nvidia's earnings and the Federal Reserve's meeting minutes due on November 18. Options positioning has turned defensive, with the $60,000 put on Deribit becoming the largest open-interest position at about $900 million, overtaking the $100,000 call. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $1.07 billion in net outflows last week, their third consecutive week of withdrawals.

title.zh: 以太币守住1800美元，巨鲸逢低买入，期货未平仓合约降至2024年10月以来最低
title.en: Ether holds above $1,800 as whales buy the dip and futures open interest falls to its lowest since October 2024

summary.zh: 以太币（Ether）周二反弹至约1833美元，此前周末一度跌至约1712美元，为7月以来最低；与巨鲸（whale）钱包相关的地址据报买入约8.2万枚ETH，Bitmine同期增持7653枚ETH。与此同时，以太坊期货未平仓合约（Open Interest）降至约91.2亿美元，为2024年10月以来最低；美国现货以太坊ETF（Spot ETF）连续第七周净流出，上周流出约3.989亿美元。
summary.en: Ether rebounded to about $1,833 on Tuesday after sliding toward $1,712 over the weekend, its lowest since July, while wallets linked to ShapeShift founder Erik Voorhees reportedly bought about 82,277 ETH and Bitmine added 7,653 ETH. At the same time, Ethereum futures open interest fell to about $9.12 billion, its lowest since October 2024. U.S. spot Ether ETFs posted a seventh straight week of net outflows, losing about $398.9 million last week.

title.zh: 纽交所母公司ICE考虑运营Solana验证节点，深化与Solana的合作
title.en: NYSE owner ICE considers running a Solana validator as it deepens ties with the network

summary.zh: 纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）正考虑运营Solana验证节点，其ICE Clear Europe总裁Hester Serafini在Solana Breakpoint大会上表示，公司已在研究这一可能性。ICE表示，其数字资产托管业务ICE Digital Trust已支持Solana，纽交所的数字化另类交易系统（ATS）也可接受在Solana上发行的代币化证券。不过ICE尚未作出正式决定，也未公布时间表。
summary.en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, is considering operating a Solana validator, ICE Clear Europe President Hester Serafini said at the Solana Breakpoint conference in London. ICE said its digital-asset custodian, ICE Digital Trust, already supports Solana, and the NYSE's digital alternative trading system (ATS) is set up to accept tokenised securities issued on Solana. No formal decision or timeline has been disclosed.

title.zh: 俄罗斯散户加密交易规则今日生效，比特币、以太币与USDT获准上架，年度购买上限30万卢布
title.en: Russia's retail crypto trading rules take effect today: Bitcoin, Ether and USDT approved for exchanges, with a 300,000-ruble annual purchase cap

summary.zh: 俄罗斯央行指令今日正式生效，允许交易所向普通投资者开放比特币（Bitcoin）、以太币（Ether）与泰达币（USDT）的交易。非合格投资者通过每家中介每年的购买总额不得超过30万卢布（约3700美元），合格投资者则不受上限限制；所有投资者交易前须通过适当性测试并确认了解风险。莫斯科交易所计划12月1日启动加密交易试点。
summary.en: A Bank of Russia directive takes effect today, allowing domestic exchanges to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether's USDT to ordinary investors. Non-qualified investors are capped at 300,000 rubles (about $3,700) of purchases per year through each intermediary, while qualified investors face no cap; all investors must pass a suitability test and acknowledge the risks before trading. Moscow Exchange plans to start crypto trading on December 1 with pilot transactions.

title.zh: 比特币守住64000美元，币安创始人赵长鹏就市场走弱列出可能原因
title.en: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 after weekend low as Binance co-founder CZ lists possible reasons for the weakness

summary.zh: 比特币在周末跌至约62000美元的四个月低点后，周一反弹并守住64000美元附近，过去24小时波动有限，但过去七天仍下跌约12.6%。币安联合创始人赵长鹏（CZ）列举了市场走弱的几种可能解释，同时提醒真正原因尚不明确。市场关注比特币能否重新站上66000美元，否则可能进一步下探60000美元关口。
summary.en: Bitcoin rebounded from a four-month low near $62,000 over the weekend and held around $64,000 on Monday, with limited movement over the past 24 hours but still down about 12.6% over seven days. Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao listed several possible explanations for the market weakness while cautioning that the real cause remains unclear. Traders are watching whether Bitcoin can reclaim $66,000 or risks sliding toward $60,000.

title.zh: 以太币反弹至约1830美元，但11月现货ETF已净流出7.64亿美元
title.en: Ether rebounds to about $1,830, but spot ETF outflows have reached $764 million in November

summary.zh: 以太币周一反弹至约1830美元，24小时上涨约3.8%，此前周日曾跌至约1714美元；但过去一周仍下跌约14%。资金面依然承压：11月美国现货以太坊ETF（Spot ETF）净流出约7.64亿美元，10月流出达16.1亿美元，期货未平仓合约（Open Interest）也从9月峰值360亿美元降至约233亿美元。
summary.en: Ether rebounded to about $1,830 on Monday, up roughly 3.8% in 24 hours after falling to about $1,714 on Sunday, but it remains down around 14% over the week. Fund flows stay weak: U.S. spot Ether ETFs have seen about $764 million in net outflows in November, following $1.61 billion in October, while futures open interest has fallen to about $23.3 billion from a September peak of $36 billion.

title.zh: Zelle选择Solana发行稳定币ZelleUSD，瞄准跨境支付，印度为首个走廊
title.en: Zelle picks Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin, targeting cross-border payments with India as the first corridor

summary.zh: 美国点对点支付网络Zelle在伦敦Breakpoint 2026大会上宣布，其美元稳定币ZelleUSD（ZLUSD）将发行在Solana链上，用于国际点对点支付，发行方为Anchorage Digital Bank。Zelle由多家美国大型银行共同拥有，2025年处理了超过1.2万亿美元的美国境内支付；印度被定为首个国际走廊，目标在2026年底前上线。现场还演示了一笔125万美元的保密转账，但演示在测试网进行，尚未公布面向消费者的上线时间。
summary.en: U.S. peer-to-peer payments network Zelle announced at the Breakpoint 2026 conference in London that its dollar-backed stablecoin ZelleUSD (ZLUSD) will launch on Solana for international peer-to-peer payments, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank. Zelle, owned by a consortium of major U.S. banks, processed more than $1.2 trillion in U.S. payments in 2025; India is its first international corridor, targeted to go live by the end of 2026. The event included a $1.25 million confidential-transfer demo on a test network, with no consumer launch date announced.

title.zh: Strategy上周再购485枚比特币，总持仓达850849枚，账面浮亏约96亿美元
title.en: Strategy buys 485 more Bitcoin, taking holdings to 850,849 BTC with about $9.6 billion in paper losses

summary.zh: Strategy（原MicroStrategy）周一提交的8-K文件显示，公司在11月9日至15日以约3340万美元增持485枚比特币，均价约68887美元，总持仓升至850849枚，总成本约642亿美元，均价75452美元。按比特币约64154美元的市价计算，其持仓账面浮亏约96亿美元。同期公司还斥资2.281亿美元回购优先股STRC，资金来自出售MSTR股票所得的2.447亿美元。
summary.en: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) disclosed in a Form 8-K filed on Monday that it bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million between November 9 and 15, at an average of about $68,887 per coin, lifting total holdings to 850,849 BTC acquired for about $64.20 billion at an average of $75,452. With Bitcoin trading near $64,154, the treasury sits about $9.6 billion underwater on paper. The company also spent $228.1 million buying back STRC preferred shares, funded by $244.7 million raised from selling MSTR stock.

title.zh: Solana告别“主网测试版”标签，推出Solana 1.0，Alpenglow将最终确认时间缩短至约150毫秒
title.en: Solana drops its 'mainnet beta' label with Solana 1.0 as Alpenglow cuts finality to about 150 milliseconds

summary.zh: Solana基金会在Breakpoint 2026大会上宣布，网络正式告别自2020年3月上线以来沿用的“主网测试版”（mainnet beta）标签，推出Solana 1.0作为统一的协议版本号。这一变化的背后是10月上线的Alpenglow共识升级，它将交易最终确认时间（finality）从约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒，以及Jump Crypto开发的独立验证者客户端Firedancer已上线主网。基金会表示，用户持有的SOL、账户与应用均不受影响，无需任何操作。
summary.en: The Solana Foundation announced at the Breakpoint 2026 conference that the network has formally retired the 'mainnet beta' label it has carried since its March 2020 launch, introducing Solana 1.0 as a shared protocol version. The move follows the October activation of the Alpenglow consensus upgrade, which cut transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to around 150 milliseconds, and the deployment of Firedancer, Jump Crypto's independently developed validator client, on mainnet. The Foundation said SOL holdings, accounts and applications are unaffected and users need to take no action.

title.zh: 以太坊开发者转向抗量子安全路线，Vitalik支持leanPCS方案（EIP-8288）
title.en: Ethereum developers shift toward post-quantum security as Vitalik backs the leanPCS proposal (EIP-8288)

summary.zh: 以太坊核心开发者在11月12日的共识层电话会议上决定，优先推进抗量子（post-quantum）替代方案，EIP-8483进入“拟纳入”状态，为未来注册抗量子密钥材料铺路，而EIP-8198快速时隙方案则被推迟。与此同时，联合创始人Vitalik Buterin公开支持leanPCS密码学框架（草案EIP-8288），该方案通过递归STARK聚合抗量子签名。相关工作仍处于早期阶段，尚未影响主网运行。
summary.en: Ethereum core developers decided at the November 12 consensus-layer call to prioritize post-quantum alternatives: EIP-8483 advanced to Proposed for Inclusion, creating a route to register post-quantum key material, while the EIP-8198 Quick Slots proposal was deferred. Separately, co-founder Vitalik Buterin publicly backed leanPCS, a cryptographic framework tied to draft EIP-8288 that aggregates quantum-resistant signatures into a single recursive STARK. The work is still at an early stage and does not affect mainnet operation.

title.zh: CoW Swap在Solana上线原生交易Alpha版，首批支持USDC与wSOL兑换
title.en: CoW Swap launches native trading alpha on Solana, starting with USDC and wSOL swaps

summary.zh: CoW Swap于11月16日在Solana主网启动Alpha版，这是CoW Protocol首次在以太坊兼容链之外实现原生部署。Alpha版初期仅支持USDC与封装SOL（wSOL）一个交易对，沿用其求解器批量拍卖（solver batch auction）的执行模式；Solana借贷协议Kamino将在上线时集成CoW Protocol。CoW DAO此前已提议12个月零手续费窗口以引导流动性，完整生产版本目标为2026年第四季度。
summary.en: CoW Swap launched an alpha on Solana mainnet on November 16, marking CoW Protocol's first native deployment outside Ethereum-compatible chains. The alpha initially supports a single pair, USDC and wrapped SOL (wSOL), using its solver-run batch auction execution model; Solana lending protocol Kamino is integrating CoW Protocol at launch. A CoW DAO proposal outlined a 12-month zero-fee window to bootstrap liquidity, with full production targeted for Q4 2026.

title.zh: 比特币跌至62080美元四个月低点，24小时爆仓近20亿美元，恐慌指数跌至10
title.en: Bitcoin falls to $62,080, a four-month low, as nearly $2 billion is liquidated in 24 hours and fear hits extreme levels

summary.zh: 比特币周末跌至约62080美元，创7月以来最低，随后反弹至65000美元上方；过去10天加密货币总市值蒸发约5710亿美元。CoinGlass数据显示，24小时内约19.5亿美元杠杆仓位被强制平仓，其中多头（Long）占约16.7亿美元。加密货币恐惧与贪婪指数（Crypto Fear & Greed Index）跌至10，进入极度恐慌（Extreme Fear）区间。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell to about $62,080 over the weekend, its lowest since July, before recovering above $65,000, while the total crypto market capitalization has shed roughly $571 billion in ten days. CoinGlass data shows about $1.95 billion in leveraged positions was liquidated in 24 hours, with longs accounting for roughly $1.67 billion. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped to 10, deep in extreme fear territory.

title.zh: Solana跌至67.37美元盘中低点，Breakpoint 2026在伦敦开幕
title.en: Solana drops to $67.37 intraday low as Breakpoint 2026 opens in London

summary.zh: Solana周末一度跌至67.37美元，周跌幅约20%，随后回升至71美元附近；24小时内约6900万至9000万美元的SOL期货仓位被清算，其中多头（Long）占绝大部分。下跌恰逢Solana Breakpoint 2026大会于11月15日至17日在伦敦开幕，议题涵盖机构代币化（Tokenization）、稳定币（Stablecoin）与支付。尽管价格承压，Solana网络状态页面显示主网运行正常。
summary.en: Solana fell as low as $67.37 over the weekend, a weekly decline of about 20%, before recovering toward $71. Roughly $69 million to $90 million in SOL futures positions were liquidated in 24 hours, mostly longs. The slide coincides with Solana Breakpoint 2026, running November 15-17 in London with a focus on institutional tokenization, stablecoins and payments, while the network's status page shows mainnet operating normally.

title.zh: 比特币反弹至65000美元上方，美国现货比特币ETF两周净流出23.5亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin rebounds above $65,000 as US spot bitcoin ETFs record $2.35 billion in outflows over two weeks

summary.zh: 比特币在触及约62000美元后反弹至约65500美元，但一周跌幅仍接近15%。美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）连续七个交易日净流出，两周合计流出约23.5亿美元；贝莱德（BlackRock）的IBIT已连续11个交易日流出。市场关注周一公布的ETF资金流数据，以判断机构赎回是否放缓。
summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to about $65,500 after touching roughly $62,000, though it remains nearly 15% lower on the week. US spot bitcoin ETFs have now seen seven straight sessions of outflows, totaling about $2.35 billion over two weeks, with BlackRock's IBIT logging its 11th consecutive session of redemptions. Traders are watching Monday's ETF flow data for signs of whether institutional redemptions are easing.

title.zh: 以太坊跌破1800美元，币安ETH储备降至近五年低点
title.en: Ether falls below $1,800 as Binance ETH reserves hit a near five-year low

summary.zh: 以太坊周末一度跌至约1713美元，周跌幅约19.5%，随后回升至1830美元附近。CryptoQuant数据显示，币安（Binance）的ETH储备降至约290万枚，为近五年最低，较2025年7月的逾500万枚下降约42%。美国现货以太坊ETF（Spot Ether ETF）当周净流出约3.99亿美元，但周五录得230万美元小幅净流入，结束了连续六个交易日的流出。
summary.en: Ether fell as low as about $1,713 over the weekend, a weekly decline of roughly 19.5%, before recovering to near $1,830. CryptoQuant data shows Binance's ETH reserves have dropped to about 2.9 million, their lowest in nearly five years and down about 42% from more than 5 million in July 2025. US spot ether ETFs lost about $398.9 million for the week, though a modest $2.3 million inflow on Friday ended a six-day outflow streak.

title.zh: 泰国SEC拟对稳定币转账设每日500万泰铢上限，征求意见至11月26日
title.en: Thailand's SEC proposes a daily 5 million baht cap on stablecoin transfers, with comments open until November 26

summary.zh: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）发布草案，拟将每位客户在每个持牌运营商处的稳定币存取上限设为每日500万泰铢（约14.8万美元），存入与取出分别计算。草案还要求稳定币只能在同一人持有名下的账户或钱包之间转移，旨在打击洗钱（Money Laundering）、网络犯罪与规避跨境汇款规则的行为。草案目前公开征求意见，截止日期为11月26日，尚未生效。
summary.en: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission has published a draft that would cap each customer's stablecoin deposits and withdrawals at 5 million baht (about $148,000) per day per licensed operator, with the limit applied separately in each direction. The draft would also require stablecoins to move only between accounts or wallets belonging to the same person, aiming to combat money laundering, cybercrime and evasion of cross-border transfer rules. The proposal is open for public comment until November 26 and is not yet in force.

title.zh: ZetaChain治理投票通过，12月9日关闭L1并将ZETA迁移至Solana
title.en: ZetaChain governance approves shutdown of its L1 on December 9 and migration of ZETA to Solana

summary.zh: ZetaChain社区以逾99.99%的支持率、83%的投票率通过治理提案2，决定于约12月9日在区块高度20,755,000停止其Layer 1网络出块，ZETA将按1:1兑换为Solana上的SPL代币。约5500万枚未分配的验证者奖励ZETA将在2027年内分月销毁，总供应量将降至20.45亿枚；ZetaChain的AI产品ZetaLabs也将于12月9日上线。此前9月20日通过的提案68已确立迁移的基本方针。
summary.en: ZetaChain holders have approved Governance Proposal 2 with more than 99.99% support and 83% turnout, deciding to halt block production on its layer-1 network at block height 20,755,000 around December 9, with ZETA migrating 1:1 to a Solana SPL token. About 55 million undistributed validator-reward ZETA will be burned monthly through 2027, cutting total supply to 2.045 billion, and ZetaChain's AI product ZetaLabs launches the same day. An earlier proposal passed on September 20 had already set the migration's basic direction.

title.zh: 币安与Polymarket提议Polygon硬分叉，追回约7049万枚被盗POL
title.en: Binance and Polymarket propose a Polygon hard fork to recover about 70.49 million stolen POL

summary.zh: 币安（Binance）与Polymarket联合提议对Polygon PoS网络进行一次性硬分叉（Hard Fork），将5个攻击者地址中约7049万枚POL（约650万至680万美元）转移至经核实的追回钱包，其中约4663万枚与币安事件相关、约2386万枚与Polymarket事件相关。提案不改变POL总供应量，但目前尚未获批，仍需治理批准、Amoy测试网测试与验证者协调。Polygon出块方已临时冻结相关地址的交易，但该限制不足以返还资金。
summary.en: Binance and Polymarket have jointly proposed a one-time hard fork of the Polygon PoS network to move about 70.49 million POL (roughly $6.5-6.8 million) from five attacker-controlled addresses to verified recovery wallets — about 46.63 million POL tied to the Binance incident and 23.86 million to Polymarket. The proposal would not change POL's total supply, but it has not been approved and still needs governance approval, testing on the Amoy testnet and validator coordination. Polygon block producers have temporarily blocked transactions from the affected addresses, a restriction that alone cannot return the funds.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级Hoodi测试网部署暂停，审计发现8处Gas计量问题
title.en: Ethereum pauses Glamsterdam deployment on Hoodi testnet after audit flags eight gas-accounting issues

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会（Ethereum Foundation）宣布暂停Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网（Testnet）的部署，此前ChainSecurity的审计发现与EIP-8037和EIP-8038相关的8处Gas计量不变量（Gas Accounting Invariant）被破坏。基金会已开设审计仓库，帮助合约开发者对照新规则验证应用逻辑，同时后续Hegota升级的工程工作继续推进。Glamsterdam此前已于10月6日在Sepolia测试网激活，原定10月26日部署至Hoodi。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation has paused deployment of the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet after an audit by ChainSecurity identified eight breaks in gas-accounting invariants tied to EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. The Foundation has opened an auditing repository to help contract authors verify their application logic against the new rules, while engineering on the subsequent Hegota upgrade continues. Glamsterdam had activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 and was scheduled for Hoodi on October 26.

title.zh: 民主党赢得国会两院，CLARITY法案须在2027年1月3日前通过否则重头再来
title.en: Democrats win both chambers of Congress, leaving the CLARITY Act until January 3, 2027 or it must start over

summary.zh: 民主党在11月3日中期选举中赢得众议院与参议院控制权，新一届国会将于2027年1月就职。加密市场结构法案CLARITY法案（CLARITY Act）今年9月15日在参议院以49比50未能启动辩论，若未能在2027年1月3日本届国会结束前通过，法案将失效并须在新一届国会重新提出。伊丽莎白·沃伦（Elizabeth Warren）有望出任参议院银行委员会主席；已立法的稳定币法案GENIUS法案（GENIUS Act）不受影响，将于2027年1月18日生效。
summary.en: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in the November 3 midterm elections, with the new Congress seated in January 2027. The CLARITY Act, the crypto market-structure bill, failed a Senate procedural vote 49-50 on September 15 and will die if it does not pass by January 3, 2027, when the current Congress ends, forcing it to be reintroduced from scratch. Elizabeth Warren is in line to chair the Senate Banking Committee, while the already-enacted GENIUS stablecoin law is unaffected and takes effect on January 18, 2027.

title.zh: Kava Lend遭黑客攻击损失约380万美元，KAVA暴跌约40%
title.en: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack as KAVA plunges about 40%

summary.zh: 攻击者利用Kava Lend中一个近乎闲置的BUSD (Binance USD) 稳定币市场操纵存款价值，在约一个半小时内借出约5520万枚KAVA (约376万美元)，随后将大部分代币跨链至BNB Chain (BNB Smart Chain) 并以约209万美元卖出。Kava表示事件已隔离在Kava Lend内部，并非无限增发，同时暂停了Axelar跨链桥；Upbit、Bithumb与Coinone已暂停KAVA存取款，KAVA 24小时内下跌约40%。
summary.en: An attacker exploited a near-dormant BUSD stablecoin market on Kava Lend to inflate deposit values and borrow about 55.2 million KAVA, worth roughly $3.76 million, in about ninety minutes, then bridged most of it to BNB Chain and sold it for around $2.1 million. Kava said the incident is isolated to Kava Lend and is not an infinite mint, and it paused its Axelar bridge as a precaution, while Upbit, Bithumb and Coinone suspended KAVA deposits and withdrawals. KAVA fell about 40% in 24 hours.

title.zh: 比特币短暂跌破6.5万美元，以太坊与Solana跌幅更深，24小时爆仓超8.56亿美元
