title.en: Bitcoin briefly falls below $65,000 as ether and solana drop harder and liquidations top $856 million in 24 hours

summary.zh: 比特币周六一度跌至约6.5万美元，为8月以来最低，周线料将连续第六周收跌；以太坊跌至约1808美元、Solana跌至约71.84美元，均为7月下旬以来最低。过去24小时全网爆仓金额超过8.56亿美元，其中多头占约7.72亿美元；加密恐惧与贪婪指数 (Crypto Fear & Greed Index) 降至12，进入极度恐惧 (Extreme Fear) 区间。
summary.en: Bitcoin briefly fell to about $65,000 on Saturday, its lowest since August and on course for a sixth straight weekly loss, while ether dropped to about $1,808 and solana to about $71.84, their lowest levels since late July and early August. More than $856 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, roughly $772 million of it longs, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 12, deep in extreme fear territory.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF连续第七天净流出，七个交易日合计流失19.1亿美元
title.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs post a seventh straight day of outflows, losing $1.91 billion in seven sessions

summary.zh: 美国12只现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 周五净流出1.855亿美元，为连续第七个交易日净流出，自11月5日以来累计流出约19.1亿美元；上周净流出10.7亿美元，是连续第二周流出超过10亿美元。贝莱德IBIT占周五流出的约77%，其连亏纪录已达11个交易日；11月以来比特币ETF累计净流出已达23.5亿美元。
summary.en: The 12 US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $185.5 million in net outflows on Friday, a seventh consecutive daily loss that has drained about $1.91 billion since November 5, with $1.07 billion leaving last week alone — the second straight week of outflows above $1 billion. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for about 77% of Friday's outflow and is on an 11-session losing streak, while November outflows have reached $2.35 billion.

title.zh: Solana跌至约70美元，为8月初以来最低，现货ETF连续第五天净流出
title.en: Solana falls to about $70, its lowest since early August, as spot ETFs log a fifth straight day of outflows

summary.zh: Solana周六24小时内下跌约11.6%至约70.55美元，盘中一度触及约69美元，为8月初以来最低，过去7天累计下跌约20.7%。美国现货Solana ETF (Spot Solana ETF) 已连续第五天净流出，累计流出约5330万美元；市场情绪极度悲观，恐惧与贪婪指数 (Fear & Greed Index) 降至12。
summary.en: Solana fell about 11.6% in 24 hours to roughly $70.55 on Saturday, touching about $69 intraday for its lowest price since early August and a weekly drop of about 20.7%. US spot solana ETFs recorded a fifth consecutive day of outflows, totaling about $53.3 million, while market sentiment stayed deeply bearish with the Fear & Greed Index at 12.

title.zh: 以太坊跌破1900美元创7月中旬以来新低，以太坊基金会关联钱包五天售出5000枚ETH
title.en: Ether falls below $1,900 to its lowest since mid-July as an Ethereum Foundation-linked wallet sells 5,000 ETH in five days

summary.zh: 以太坊周六跌至约1808美元，为7月中旬以来最低，过去7天下跌约15%。与以太坊基金会 (Ethereum Foundation) 关联的钱包在11月10日至14日五天内售出5000枚ETH (约992万美元)，最新一批1000枚ETH通过CoWSwap兑换为USDS稳定币；该钱包仍持有约1万枚ETH。
summary.en: Ether fell to about $1,808 on Saturday, its lowest since mid-July and down roughly 15% over seven days. A wallet linked to the Ethereum Foundation sold 5,000 ETH, worth about $9.92 million, over five days from November 10 to 14, with the latest 1,000 ETH tranche swapped for the USDS stablecoin via CoWSwap; the wallet still holds about 10,000 ETH.

title.zh: Pump.fun累计已售出约8.876亿美元SOL，最新一批6.47万枚转入Kraken
title.en: Pump.fun has now sold about $887.6 million in SOL, sending a fresh 64,666 SOL to Kraken

summary.zh: Solana迷因币发行平台Pump.fun于11月13日至14日再次向Kraken转入6.47万枚SOL (约519万美元)，其累计售出的SOL达到约562万枚，按平均价格158美元计算约合8.876亿美元。链上分析机构Arkham的数据显示，Pump.fun自2024年初以来一直在将收取的手续费收入兑换为现金；按当前约75美元的价格计算，这些已售SOL如今仅值约4.26亿美元。
summary.en: Memecoin launchpad Pump.fun deposited another 64,666 SOL, worth about $5.19 million, into Kraken on November 13–14, taking its cumulative sales to about 5.62 million SOL, worth roughly $887.6 million at an average price of $158. On-chain data from Arkham shows the platform has been converting fee revenue collected in SOL into cash since early 2024; at the current price of about $75, the SOL it sold would be worth only around $426 million.

title.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF连续第六天净流出，六个交易日合计流出约5.32亿美元
title.en: US spot ether ETFs log a sixth straight day of outflows, totaling about $532 million over six sessions

summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 在最新交易日净流出7050万美元，为连续第六天净流出，六个交易日累计流出约5.319亿美元。资金持续外流之际，以太坊价格已跌破2000美元关口；周一公布的最新资金流数据将显示这轮流出是否延续。
summary.en: US spot ether ETFs recorded $70.5 million in net outflows in the latest session, a sixth consecutive day of redemptions totaling about $531.9 million over six sessions. The sustained outflows come as ether has fallen below the $2,000 level, and Monday's flow data will show whether the streak continues.

title.zh: 美国10月PPI同比上涨6.5%创近四年新高，12月加息概率升至约88%
title.en: US October PPI rises 6.5% year over year, the highest in nearly four years, as December hike odds climb to about 88%

summary.zh: 美国10月生产者价格指数 (Producer Price Index, PPI) 同比上涨6.5%，为2022年11月以来最高，略低于6.6%的预期；数据公布后，市场对美联储 (Federal Reserve) 12月加息25个基点的预期升至约88%。10年期美债收益率 (10-Year Treasury Yield) 升至5.15%，利率走高令包括加密货币在内的风险资产承压。
summary.en: US producer prices rose 6.5% year over year in October, the highest reading since November 2022 and just under the 6.6% forecast, pushing market-implied odds of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December to about 88%. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 5.15%, and higher rates are weighing on risk assets including crypto.

title.zh: 币安警告iOS漏洞worse_query可泄露钱包助记词，最新系统仍未修复
title.en: Binance warns iOS flaw worse_query can expose wallet seed phrases, and the latest update does not fix it

summary.zh: 币安于11月10日警告，iOS沙箱逃逸漏洞worse_query可让恶意应用读取其他应用的本地文件，可能泄露加密钱包的助记词 (Seed Phrase)、私钥与登录凭证；受影响版本包括iOS 26.7.1、27.0.1与27.2。研究人员于11月8日公开了概念验证代码 (Proof of Concept)，并表示iOS 27.2.1与27.3测试版仍未修复该漏洞；目前尚无与该漏洞相关的盗窃报告。
summary.en: Binance warned on November 10 that worse_query, an iOS sandbox escape, can let a malicious app read other apps' local files, potentially exposing crypto wallet seed phrases, private keys and login credentials on iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2. Researchers published proof-of-concept code on November 8 and say the flaw remains unpatched in iOS 27.2.1 and the iOS 27.3 beta; no thefts tied to the flaw have been reported.

title.zh: Coinbase获美国货币监理署最终批准，设立联邦特许国民信托公司
title.en: Coinbase wins final OCC approval to operate a federally chartered national trust company

summary.zh: Coinbase于11月9日宣布，美国货币监理署 (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, OCC) 已最终批准设立Coinbase National Trust Company，特许于11月6日生效；公司计划在三年内将现有托管业务迁入该联邦信托公司。获得特许并不意味着Coinbase成为传统商业银行：该信托公司不接受普通存款、不发放贷款、也不发行稳定币，且前三年须持有至少6000万美元一级资本 (Tier 1 Capital)。
summary.en: Coinbase announced on November 9 that the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has given final approval for Coinbase National Trust Company, with the charter effective November 6, and plans to move its existing custody business into the federal trust company over three years. The charter does not make Coinbase a traditional bank: the trust cannot accept ordinary deposits, make loans or issue stablecoins, and must hold at least $60 million in Tier 1 capital for its first three years.

title.zh: Trezor确认三台CryptoBilis售出Safe 5钱包藏有窃取助记词的植入硬件
title.en: Trezor confirms hidden implants in three Safe 5 wallets sold by CryptoBilis

summary.zh: 硬件钱包厂商Trezor于11月13日确认，经销商CryptoBilis售出的三台Safe 5钱包内藏有额外电路板，可在屏幕显示助记词 (Recovery Phrase) 时将其复制并通过移动网络发送给攻击者。Trezor于11月11日发布的固件 (Firmware) 2.13.1可使已发现的植入失效，但无法保护此前已被窃取的助记词；公司同时将授权经销商网络缩减约80%。自3月以来通过CryptoBilis购买过Trezor钱包的用户被建议将资产转移至使用新助记词的新钱包。
summary.en: Hardware wallet maker Trezor confirmed on November 13 that three Safe 5 wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis contained an extra circuit board that copies the recovery phrase shown on screen and transmits it to attackers over a mobile network. Firmware 2.13.1, released November 11, disables the implants found so far but cannot protect phrases captured before installation; Trezor also cut its authorized reseller network by about 80%. Anyone who bought a Trezor from CryptoBilis since March is advised to move funds to a new wallet with a fresh recovery phrase.

title.zh: 特朗普提名四名SEC与CFTC委员，CLARITY法案确认搁浅
title.en: Trump nominates four SEC and CFTC commissioners as CLARITY Act stalls

summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普于11月12日向参议院提名四名人选填补证券交易委员会 (SEC) 与商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 的空缺，其中包括接替知名加密倡导者Hester Peirce的Steven Levine；四人均需参议院确认。提名之际，加密市场结构法案CLARITY Act已确认在参议院搁浅，前CFTC主席Giancarlo表示该法案在最后六个月中“缓慢死亡”。两家机构目前正依据现有职权推进加密规则制定，但民主党将于明年1月掌控参议院，留给共和党确认提名的时间窗口有限。
summary.en: US President Donald Trump on November 12 nominated four people to fill vacancies at the SEC and CFTC, including Steven Levine to succeed prominent crypto advocate Hester Peirce; all four require Senate confirmation. The nominations come as the crypto market-structure bill known as the CLARITY Act has stalled in the Senate, with former CFTC Chair Chris Giancarlo saying it "died a slow death" in its final six months. Both agencies are now writing crypto rules under existing authority, but with Democrats set to take Senate control in January, Republicans have only a narrow window to confirm the slate.

title.zh: 以太坊基金会关联钱包第四次出售2,000枚ETH
title.en: Ethereum Foundation-linked wallet sells 2,000 ETH for a fourth time

summary.zh: 链上分析机构Lookonchain追踪的、归属于以太坊基金会 (Ethereum Foundation) 的钱包于11月13日再度出售2,000枚ETH，约合387万美元，为10月12日以来第四轮出售。11月以来该钱包累计出售4,000枚ETH，约合803万美元；相比之下，美国现货以太币ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 11月前11天净流出达6.959亿美元，约为基金会出售规模的87倍。基金会出售更多被视为情绪信号，真正影响价格的是基金资金流向。
summary.en: A wallet attributed by on-chain analytics firm Lookonchain to the Ethereum Foundation sold another 2,000 ETH on November 13 for about $3.87 million, the fourth round of sales since October 12. The wallet has sold 4,000 ETH for about $8.03 million in November, while US spot ether ETFs saw $695.9 million in net outflows over the first 11 days of the month — roughly 87 times as much. The foundation's sales are seen mainly as a sentiment signal, with fund flows doing far more to move the price.

title.zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，AI代理可代用户完成支付
title.en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, letting AI agents pay for purchases

summary.zh: OpenAI于11月13日推出ChatGPT Wallet，允许其AI代理 (AI Agent) 在用户逐笔授权后代为完成购物支付，卡号以一次性网络令牌 (Network Token) 替代，不向代理或商家暴露真实卡信息。该功能与美国运通 (American Express)、万事达卡 (Mastercard) 和Visa合作开发，初期仅面向美国年满18岁的ChatGPT Pro订阅用户。OpenAI表示上线初期不从交易中抽成，重点是与商家、银行和支付网络磨合兼容性。
summary.en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, letting its AI agents complete purchases on a user's behalf after per-transaction approval, with a one-time network token standing in for the real card number so neither the agent nor the merchant sees it. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, the wallet is initially limited to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and older. OpenAI said it will take no cut of transactions at launch, focusing instead on compatibility with merchants, banks and payment networks.

title.zh: 比特币考验200周均线约6.8万美元，分析师争论是否已见底
title.en: Bitcoin tests 200-week moving average near $68,000 as analysts debate a bottom

summary.zh: 比特币于11月13日跌至约6.8万美元附近，考验200周移动平均线 (200-Week Moving Average) 约6.8万美元一线；分析师Doctor Profit认为该均线历史上可靠地标志着熊市底部，并表示正在该价位附近大举买入。Glassnode数据显示，主要交易所6.8万至7.25万美元区间存在密集买单；但批评者指出，持续的ETF资金流出与清算压力仍可能推动价格进一步下探，市场对该位置能否守住存在明显分歧。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell toward $68,000 on November 13, testing its 200-week moving average near that level, which analyst Doctor Profit argues has reliably marked bear market lows and says he is buying heavily around. Glassnode data showed dense buy orders clustered between $68,000 and $72,500 on major exchanges, but skeptics note persistent ETF outflows and liquidation pressure could still push prices lower. The market is split on whether the level will hold.

title.zh: DTCC计划2027年下半年在Solana上实现托管资产代币化
title.en: DTCC plans tokenization of custodied assets on Solana by second half of 2027

summary.zh: 美国存管信托与清算公司 (DTCC) 于11月12日宣布，计划在2027年下半年将其代币化服务 (Tokenization Service) 接入Solana网络，支持对DTCC托管资产的代币化及相关资产全生命周期功能，同时保留传统证券的投资者保护与所有权。消息为Solana的机构叙事再添一笔，但SOL价格当日仍随大市走低。分析认为，该整合若落地，将是传统金融基础设施对公链的又一次重要采用。
summary.en: The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) announced on November 12 that it plans to connect its Tokenization Service with Solana by the second half of 2027, supporting tokenization of DTC-custodied assets and related asset lifecycle functions while retaining the investor protections and ownership rights of traditionally held securities. The news bolstered Solana's institutional narrative, though SOL still fell with the broader market that day. If delivered, the integration would mark another major adoption of a public chain by traditional financial infrastructure.

title.zh: 稳定币供应30天缩水142亿美元，创2022年6月以来最大降幅
title.en: Stablecoin supply shrinks $14.2 billion in 30 days, largest drop since June 2022

summary.zh: Glassnode于11月11日发布的研究显示，主要稳定币 (Stablecoin) 总供应量在截至11月9日的30天内减少142亿美元，为2022年6月以来最大降幅，总量回落至2,800亿美元以下。美元流动性收缩与现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 持续资金流出叠加，被视为本轮加密市场抛售的重要背景。分析指出，稳定币供应是衡量市场购买力的重要指标，其收缩意味着承接卖盘的资金减少。
summary.en: Glassnode research published November 11 showed total major stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in the 30 days through November 9, the largest decline since June 2022, taking the total below $280 billion. The contraction in dollar liquidity, combined with continued outflows from spot bitcoin ETFs, is seen as a key backdrop to the crypto selloff. Stablecoin supply is widely watched as a gauge of buying power, and its shrinkage means less capital is available to absorb selling.

title.zh: 以太坊跌破2,000美元，11月现货ETF净流出近7亿美元
title.en: Ethereum falls below $2,000 as spot ETF outflows near $700 million in November

summary.zh: 以太坊 (ETH) 于11月13日跌破2,000美元关口，日内低点约1,894美元，24小时内约2.59亿美元杠杆头寸被清算。美国现货以太币ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 11月前11天累计净流出6.959亿美元，其中11月11日单日流出1.448亿美元，贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的ETHA占1.298亿美元。以太坊质押退出队列 (Exit Queue) 中约27万枚ETH等待退出，等待时间约5天14小时。
summary.en: Ethereum fell below $2,000 on November 13, touching an intraday low near $1,894, with about $259 million in leveraged positions liquidated in 24 hours. US spot ether ETFs recorded $695.9 million in net outflows over the first 11 days of November, including $144.8 million on November 11 alone, $129.8 million of it from BlackRock's ETHA. About 269,951 ETH sat in the staking exit queue, with a wait of roughly 5 days and 14 hours.

title.zh: 比特币跌至67,568美元，创8月以来新低，24小时清算16.4亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin slides to $67,568, lowest since August, as $1.64 billion is liquidated in 24 hours

summary.zh: 比特币于11月13日凌晨跌破200日移动平均线 (200-Day Moving Average) 并失守7万美元，低点触及67,568美元，为8月中旬以来最低，全市场24小时清算达16.4亿美元，涉及逾18.5万名交易者。随后美国10月生产者价格指数 (PPI) 略低于预期，比特币短暂收复7万美元，但市场情绪仍处极度恐惧区间。分析指出，ETF资金流出、杠杆清算与加息预期共同推动了本轮急跌。
summary.en: Bitcoin broke below its 200-day moving average and through $70,000 overnight on November 13, bottoming at $67,568 — its lowest since mid-August — as $1.64 billion in derivatives positions were liquidated across more than 185,000 traders in 24 hours. A cooler-than-expected US October producer price index later helped bitcoin briefly reclaim $70,000, though sentiment remained in extreme fear. Analysts point to ETF outflows, leveraged liquidations and rising rate-hike expectations behind the sharp drop.

title.zh: 美国司法部获准扣押12亿美元币安被盗资产，并打掉FaceStealer诈骗团伙
title.en: US DOJ authorized to seize $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, disrupts FaceStealer scheme

summary.zh: 美国司法部于11月13日表示，已获法院授权扣押或冻结超过12亿美元与币安10月29日被盗案相关的加密资产；该案涉案金额逾63亿美元，目前已有逾27亿美元资产被冻结。联邦调查局 (FBI) 将此次攻击归咎于朝鲜黑客组织TraderTraitor。司法部同时打掉了名为FaceStealer的朝鲜社会工程诈骗活动，该活动18个月内通过深度伪造 (Deepfake) 视频通话窃取逾4亿美元加密资产，并查获900多段受害者网络摄像头视频。
summary.en: The US Department of Justice said on November 13 it had obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto linked to the theft of over $6.3 billion from Binance on October 29, with more than $2.7 billion of the stolen assets frozen so far. The FBI attributed the hack to North Korean group TraderTraitor. The DOJ also disrupted FaceStealer, a North Korean social-engineering campaign that stole over $400 million in crypto over 18 months using deepfake video calls, seizing more than 900 webcam videos of victims.

title.zh: 加密ETF五天净流出14.8亿美元，美股ETF同期吸金375亿美元
title.en: Crypto ETFs lose $1.48 billion in five days while US stock ETFs take in $37.5 billion

summary.zh: 数据显示，11月4日至10日五个交易日内，美国现货加密ETF (Spot Crypto ETF) 净流出14.8亿美元，其中比特币基金流出10.6亿美元，以太坊基金流出3.26亿美元；同期十大美股ETF吸金375亿美元。比特币与以太坊ETF 2026年迄今合计净流出已达22.5亿美元，资金流向出现明显分化。分析认为，加密基金持有者持续撤资，而股市逢低买入迅速回流，反映出两类资产的风险偏好差异。
summary.en: US spot crypto ETFs lost $1.48 billion in net outflows over five trading days from November 4 to 10, with bitcoin funds accounting for $1.06 billion and ethereum funds $326 million, while ten major US stock ETFs attracted $37.5 billion over the same period. Combined bitcoin and ether ETF flows for 2026 through November 11 stood at $2.25 billion in net outflows, a sharp divergence in fund flows. Analysts say crypto fund holders kept withdrawing while equity buyers returned quickly after the selloff, reflecting different risk appetites.

title.zh: Solana跌破80美元，创8月中旬以来新低
title.en: Solana falls below $80, lowest since mid-August

summary.zh: Solana (SOL) 于11月13日跌破80美元关口，盘中低点约78.29美元，为8月中旬以来最低，24小时跌幅约5.7%。本轮下跌主要受大市拖累：比特币失守7万美元，杠杆头寸集中平仓；仅一小时内，币安 (Binance)、Bybit与OKX上价值1,027万美元的SOL多单被强制平仓。SOL本周累计下跌逾10%，目前交投于全部主要均线下方，下一支撑位在74.50至77美元区间。
summary.en: Solana fell below $80 on November 13, touching about $78.29 — its lowest since mid-August — and down roughly 5.7% in 24 hours. The drop was driven mainly by the broader market: bitcoin lost $70,000 and leveraged positions were forcibly closed, with $10.27 million in SOL long positions liquidated on Binance, Bybit and OKX within a single hour. SOL is down more than 10% on the week and trades below all key moving averages, with the next support zone at $74.50 to $77.

title.zh: MANTRA暂停新增解绑7天，Keplr/Web3Auth私钥泄露余波未平
title.en: MANTRA halts new unbonding for 7 days as Keplr/Web3Auth key exposure fallout spreads

summary.zh: MANTRA于11月13日宣布暂停所有新增解绑 (Unbonding) 交易7天，此前攻击者利用Web3Auth基础设施漏洞泄露的Keplr社交登录钱包私钥 (Private Key)，在盗取用户流动性代币后又未经授权发起质押解绑。链上分析机构Bitquery估计至少182万美元资产被盗，涉及7,842个Cosmos钱包；MANTRA此前已通过第41号治理提案冻结多个攻击者钱包。正在解绑的用户需在8天解绑期结束前重新委托 (Redelegate)，否则代币可能被攻击者领取。
summary.en: MANTRA said on November 13 it would suspend all new unbonding transactions for seven days after attackers used private keys exposed in the Web3Auth infrastructure flaw behind Keplr's Google and Apple logins to unstake victims' tokens without consent, having already drained their liquid holdings. On-chain firm Bitquery estimates at least $1.82 million was taken from 7,842 Cosmos wallets, and MANTRA had already frozen several attacker wallets through Governance Proposal 41. Users with unbonding in progress must redelegate before the eight-day unbonding period ends or the attackers could claim the tokens.

title.zh: 比特币跌破7万美元至12周低点，24小时爆仓16亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 to a 12-week low as $1.6 billion is liquidated in 24 hours

summary.zh: 比特币11月13日跌破7万美元心理关口，最低触及67,770美元，为8月19日以来最低；以太币 (Ether, ETH) 跌破2,000美元，同样创约三个月新低。美元指数 (Dollar Index) 升破103、创4月以来新高，交易员押注美联储 (Federal Reserve) 将在12月加息，叠加英伟达 (Nvidia) 首席执行官辞职拖累科技股，风险资产承压。CoinGlass数据显示24小时全网爆仓约16.4亿美元，其中多头占绝大多数；美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 已连续六个交易日净流出。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell below the psychologically important $70,000 level on November 13, touching as low as $67,770, its weakest since August 19, while ether dropped below $2,000, also a roughly three-month low. The dollar index rose above 103, its highest since April, as traders priced in a Federal Reserve rate increase in December, and Nvidia's chief executive resignation weighed on technology shares. CoinGlass data showed about $1.64 billion of leveraged positions liquidated in 24 hours, mostly longs, while U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs extended their outflow streak to a sixth straight session.

title.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋辞职，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯暂任掌舵
title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief

summary.zh: 英伟达11月12日向美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 提交的8-K文件显示，董事会已于11月11日接受创始人黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，立即生效；首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 出任临时首席执行官，董事哈维·琼斯 (Harvey Jones) 成为公司首任董事长。文件未说明辞职原因，也未提及董事会11月8日宣布的独立调查进展；公司定于11月17日公布财报，届时将是临时管理层首次面对投资者。
summary.en: Nvidia said in a Form 8-K filed with the SEC on November 12 that its board accepted founder Jensen Huang's resignation as president, chief executive and director on November 11, effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and director Harvey Jones becomes the company's first board chair. The filing gave no reason for the resignation and no update on the independent investigation the board announced on November 8; earnings are still scheduled for November 17, when the interim leadership will first face investors.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF今年累计资金流转负，为产品推出以来首次
title.en: U.S. spot bitcoin ETF flows turn negative for 2026, a first since launch

summary.zh: 贝莱德旗下IBIT于11月11日单日净流出2.697亿美元，推动美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 今年以来累计资金流自2024年1月推出以来首次转为负值。11月以来产品在8个交易日中仅1天净流入，月内累计净流出约19亿美元；IBIT是流出主力，月内累计流出约18亿美元。资金持续外流之际，比特币价格跌破7万美元，机构需求降温成为市场关注焦点。
summary.en: BlackRock's IBIT recorded $269.7 million of net outflows on November 11, pushing cumulative 2026 flows for U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs below zero for the first time since the products launched in January 2024. The funds have seen outflows on seven of eight November trading days, totaling about $1.9 billion for the month, with IBIT accounting for roughly $1.8 billion of the redemptions. The steady outflows coincide with bitcoin's slide below $70,000, putting cooling institutional demand in focus.

title.zh: MSCI确认将Strategy移出全球股指，11月30日收盘后生效
title.en: MSCI confirms Strategy's removal from global indexes, effective after the November 30 close

summary.zh: 指数提供商MSCI确认，将全球最大比特币上市公司持有者Strategy (MSTR) 移出其全球股票指数，11月30日收盘后生效；公司同时被移出MSCI美国指数 (MSCI USA Index)，并因此退出MSCI世界指数 (MSCI World)。此次调整源于MSCI 10月15日通过的“非经营性公司”筛查规则，东京上市的Metaplanet亦被移出。跟踪MSCI指数的基金预计需卖出约1,300万股Strategy股票，摩根大通 (JPMorgan) 估计相关抛售规模约28亿美元；市场担忧失去被动资金流入将削弱Strategy融资买币的能力。
summary.en: Index provider MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy (MSTR), the largest listed corporate holder of bitcoin, from its global equity indexes after the close on November 30, including the MSCI USA Index, which also drops it from the MSCI World index. The move follows MSCI's October 15 rule excluding 'non-operating' companies; Tokyo-listed Metaplanet was also removed. Funds tracking MSCI indexes would need to sell an estimated 13 million shares, with JPMorgan estimating about $2.8 billion of forced selling, raising questions over Strategy's ability to keep raising money for bitcoin purchases.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级停滞：两份对立提案争夺旧合约兼容方案
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade stalls as rival proposals compete to protect old contracts

summary.zh: 以太坊下一次重大升级Glamsterdam陷入停滞，两名开发者于11月8日提交对立修复方案，以防止新的Gas定价规则 (Gas Pricing) 破坏已部署的旧合约，其中部分合约持有用户资金且无法升级。以太坊基金会 (Ethereum Foundation) 要求核心开发者在ChainSecurity与Dedaub的审计结果公布前暂不作决定，审计预计11月13日至16日交付；Hoodi测试网 (Testnet) 的激活自10月26日推迟后仍无新日期。升级原计划将区块Gas上限提高至2亿，约为当前6,000万的三倍多。
summary.en: Ethereum's next major upgrade, Glamsterdam, has stalled after two developers filed rival fixes on November 8 to stop its new gas pricing rules from breaking deployed contracts, some holding user funds that cannot be upgraded. The Ethereum Foundation has asked core developers to wait until audits by ChainSecurity and Dedaub are public, with reports due between November 13 and 16; the Hoodi testnet activation postponed since October 26 still has no new date. The upgrade would raise the block gas limit to 200 million, more than three times the current 60 million.

title.zh: SEC批准纳斯达克ISE上线数字商品ETF期权，设7亿美元门槛
title.en: SEC clears Nasdaq ISE to list options on digital-commodity ETPs, setting a $700 million bar

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 于11月10日批准纳斯达克ISE期权交易所 (Nasdaq ISE) 的规则变更，允许其为持有“数字商品” (Digital Commodity) 的交易所交易产品 (ETP) 上线期权，无需逐只产品另行报批。符合条件的信托所持每种资产过去12个月日均市值须不低于7亿美元，且至少85%的净资产须对应在受监控市场有衍生品的资产。SEC同时提交法庭之友意见书，支持商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 在股票永续合约 (Perpetual Futures) 诉讼中的立场。
summary.en: The SEC on November 10 approved a Nasdaq ISE rule change letting the options exchange list options on exchange-traded products holding 'digital commodities' without seeking approval for each product. Each asset in a qualifying trust must have averaged at least $700 million in daily market value over the prior 12 months, and at least 85% of the trust's net assets must sit in assets with derivatives on surveilled markets. The SEC also filed a friend-of-the-court brief backing the CFTC in litigation over stock perpetual futures.

title.zh: 嘉信理财上线SOL现货交易，Solana ETF资金流出延续至第五周
title.en: Schwab opens spot SOL trading as Solana ETF outflows stretch to a fifth week

summary.zh: 美国券商嘉信理财 (Charles Schwab) 于11月9日向符合条件的零售客户开放Solana、Avalanche与Chainlink现货交易，每笔交易收取0.75%费用，平台可交易加密资产由此增至五种。尽管华尔街渠道扩大，美国现货Solana ETF (Spot Solana ETF) 资金流出延续至第五周，5周累计流出近1.7亿美元，SOL期货未平仓合约 (Open Interest) 降至8月19日以来最低。SOL已连续五周下跌，2026年内累计跌幅约30%。
summary.en: Charles Schwab opened spot trading in Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to eligible retail clients on November 9, charging 0.75% per trade and bringing its crypto lineup to five assets. Even as Wall Street access widened, U.S. spot Solana ETFs stretched outflows to a fifth straight week, totaling nearly $170 million over the stretch, while SOL futures open interest fell to its lowest since August 19. SOL has now fallen for five consecutive weeks and is down about 30% in 2026.

title.zh: Solana拟废除耐用随机数，回应Drift 2.7亿美元被盗案
title.en: Solana moves to retire durable nonces after Drift's $270 million exploit

summary.zh: Solana核心开发团队Anza于11月5日提交改进提案SIMD-0723，拟废除耐用随机数 (Durable Nonce) 机制——攻击者正是利用该功能在今年4月从Drift协议盗走至少2.7亿美元。提案要求所有交易改用近期区块哈希 (Blockhash)，过期后即失效；最早于2027年5月5日激活，留出至少六个月迁移期。托管机构与交易所须在此期间迁移至Anza的程序化签名器 (Programmatic Signer) 或Blueshift的Vector等替代方案。
summary.en: Anza, the team behind Solana's core validator software, filed improvement proposal SIMD-0723 on November 5 to retire durable nonces, the feature attackers exploited to drain at least $270 million from Drift Protocol in April. The change would require every transaction to use a recent blockhash that expires after about 150 blocks, with activation no earlier than May 5, 2027, leaving at least six months to migrate. Custodians and exchanges must move to replacements such as Anza's Programmatic Signer or Blueshift's Vector.

title.zh: Riot三季度抛售79%比特币持仓，转向280亿美元AI数据中心租赁
title.en: Riot sells 79% of its bitcoin holdings in Q3, pivoting to a $28 billion AI data center lease

summary.zh: 矿企Riot Platforms三季度出售10,599枚比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC)，持仓从11,380枚降至2,418枚，降幅约79%；前三季度累计出售20,264枚、套现约15亿美元，所得主要用于数据中心建设。同期公司签署为期15年、覆盖德州科西卡纳 (Corsicana) 910兆瓦算力容量的租赁协议，初始合同价值约280亿美元，租户为一家前沿人工智能实验室 (Frontier AI Lab)。这一转向显示部分矿企正把能源与场地资产从挖矿转向人工智能 (Artificial Intelligence, AI) 基础设施，但该项目约55亿美元的资本开支仍主要依赖以租赁款为支撑的融资，而融资尚未完全落实。
summary.en: Miner Riot Platforms sold 10,599 bitcoin in the third quarter, cutting its holdings from 11,380 BTC to 2,418 BTC, a drop of about 79%; across the first nine months it sold 20,264 BTC for roughly $1.5 billion, with the proceeds mainly funding data center construction. At the same time, the company signed a 15-year lease covering 910 megawatts of capacity at its Corsicana, Texas campus, valued at about $28 billion initially, with a frontier AI lab as tenant. The shift shows some miners redirecting energy and site assets from mining toward AI infrastructure, though the project still needs about $5.5 billion of capital spending backed by financing that has not yet been fully secured.

title.zh: 比特币从六周低点反弹，现货ETF单日净流出放缓至1.156亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin rebounds from six-week low as spot ETF outflows slow to $115.6 million on Nov 3

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC) 在跌破76,000美元、触及约75,736美元的六周低点后回升至78,000美元附近，收复了中期选举计票期间的大部分跌幅。美国现货ETF (Spot ETF) 11月3日净流出1.156亿美元，较11月2日的3.986亿美元大幅收窄，但三日累计流出仍约11.6亿美元，显示机构需求尚未全面恢复。Bitfinex指出此次反弹更多由杠杆驱动而非现货买盘支撑，并把75,839美元的短期持有者成本位视为关键支撑，跌破该水平将削弱反弹结构。
summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to around $78,000 after dipping below $76,000 to a six-week low near $75,736, erasing most of the losses seen during the midterm vote count. U.S. spot ETFs recorded $115.6 million of net outflows on November 3, sharply narrower than the $398.6 million on November 2, though the three-session total still reached about $1.16 billion, showing institutional demand has not fully returned. Bitfinex said the rebound looks more leverage-driven than spot-led and flagged the $75,839 short-term holder cost basis as key support, below which the recovery structure would weaken.

title.zh: 中期选举后加密市场反弹，DeFi板块领涨
title.en: Crypto market rebounds after midterm dip, led by DeFi tokens

summary.zh: 加密市场在中期选举计票引发的抛售后回升，比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC) 回到约78,300美元，以太坊 (Ethereum, ETH) 升至约2,313美元，CoinDesk的DeFi精选指数 (DeFi Select Index) 上涨约5%，表现强于大盘。市场最初因民主党赢得国会控制权而下跌，随后随美股期货转正而修复，恐惧与贪婪指数 (Fear & Greed Index) 也从26回升至34至37区间。交易员目前关注周五公布的美国10月非农就业报告，该数据可能决定反弹能否延续。
summary.en: Crypto markets recovered after the midterm-count selloff, with bitcoin back near $78,300, ether near $2,313, and CoinDesk's DeFi Select Index up about 5%, outperforming the broader market. Prices first fell as Democrats won control of Congress, then recovered as U.S. stock futures turned positive, while the fear and greed index improved from 26 into the 34-37 range. Traders are now watching Friday's U.S. October payrolls report, which could determine whether the rebound holds.

title.zh: BTCPay Server旧版本热钱包遭横扫，约162万美元被盗
title.en: BTCPay Server hot wallets drained on older versions, about $1.62 million stolen

summary.zh: 开源比特币支付处理商BTCPay Server警告称，运行2.4.1及更早版本的服务器热钱包 (Hot Wallet) 遭到未经授权的横扫，攻击者利用了与2.4.2已修复漏洞不同的手法。据Bitquery统计，被盗金额约162万美元（18.38枚比特币与3,405枚莱特币），涉及682次转移，其中87%的资金集中在11月1日的一波转移中。BTCPay Server表示最新2.4.7版本暂无可信被盗报告，并建议旧版本用户升级至2.4.7、迁移至新钱包并轮换全部密钥与凭证。
summary.en: Open-source bitcoin payment processor BTCPay Server warned that hot wallets on servers running version 2.4.1 or earlier were swept by unauthorized attackers, using a different method from the vulnerability fixed in version 2.4.2. Bitquery counted about $1.62 million stolen (18.38 BTC and 3,405 LTC) across 682 sweeps, with 87% of the funds moved in a single wave on November 1. BTCPay Server said it has no credible reports of drains on the latest 2.4.7 release and advised users on older versions to upgrade, move funds to a fresh wallet, and rotate all keys and credentials.

title.zh: 民主党赢得国会控制权，加密立法前景增添不确定性
title.en: Democrats win control of Congress, clouding crypto legislation outlook

summary.zh: 民主党在美国中期选举中赢得参众两院控制权，投资者担心亲加密立法与放松监管议程将被推迟，甚至面临更严格的监管审查，比特币与以太坊在选举结果出炉之初双双下跌。随后市场随美股反弹而修复，比特币回到约78,000美元、以太坊回到约2,300美元，但监管前景的不确定性仍未消除。市场接下来将关注新一届国会如何处理市场结构法案 (CLARITY Act) 等悬而未决的加密立法，以及监管机构的人事与执法方向。
summary.en: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, raising investor concern that pro-crypto legislation and deregulation could be delayed or face stricter regulatory scrutiny, with bitcoin and ether initially falling as results came in. Markets later recovered alongside U.S. equities, with bitcoin back near $78,000 and ether near $2,300, but the regulatory uncertainty remains. Attention now turns to how the new Congress handles pending crypto bills such as the CLARITY Act market-structure legislation, as well as regulators' staffing and enforcement direction.

title.zh: 以太坊研究员提出2028年12月完成抗量子升级目标，较路线图提前一年
title.en: Ethereum researcher targets December 2028 for post-quantum transition, a year early

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会 (Ethereum Foundation) 研究员Justin Drake在孟买Devcon 8上表示，希望以太坊在2028年12月完成抗量子 (Post-Quantum) 与后人工智能 (Post-AI) 过渡，较基金会2025年9月路线图的2029年12月目标提前一年。他同时强调这只是一个愿景而非正式期限，并不取代现有路线图，基金会预计2027年1月重新评估该路线图。要实现该目标，开发者需要在约24个月内交付三次网络升级，候选哈希签名方案包括leanSPHINCS与leanXMSS。
summary.en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake said at Devcon 8 in Mumbai that he hopes Ethereum can complete its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028, one year ahead of the foundation's September 2025 roadmap target of December 2029. He stressed the date is an aspiration rather than a confirmed deadline and does not replace the existing roadmap, which the foundation expects to reassess in January 2027. Meeting the goal would require developers to deliver three network upgrades within about 24 months, with hash-based signature candidates leanSPHINCS and leanXMSS under research.

title.zh: SEC工作人员认定Canton Coin为数字商品并给予有限不采取行动救济
title.en: SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity, granting limited no-action relief

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 公司金融部在11月3日的复函中表示，基于项目方陈述，Canton Coin (CC) 被视为数字商品 (Digital Commodity)，对其按所述方式由超级验证者、验证者与应用提供者程序化铸造的行为，工作人员不建议采取执法行动。该救济回应了Digital Asset Holdings于10月30日提交的问询，理由是该代币价值源于Canton网络的程序化运行与供需关系，且网络不存在“中心方”。工作人员同时强调，这只是执法立场而非委员会裁决，不表达法律结论，也不对该代币作出背书，事实变化可能导致结论改变。
summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's Division of Corporation Finance said in a November 3 response that, based on the project's representations, Canton Coin (CC) is viewed as a digital commodity, and staff will not recommend enforcement action over its programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers as described. The relief answers an October 30 request from Digital Asset Holdings, resting on the token deriving value from the Canton Network's programmatic operation and supply and demand, with no 'central party' controlling the network. Staff stressed this is only an enforcement position, not a Commission decision, expressing no legal conclusion and no endorsement of the token, and different facts could change the outcome.

title.zh: 币安披露63.4亿美元盗窃案始于6月供应链入侵与虚假招聘
title.en: Binance says $6.34 billion theft began with June supply-chain intrusion and fake job interviews

summary.zh: 币安在11月3日的初步事件报告中披露，约63.4亿美元盗窃案是一场始于6月的多阶段攻击：钱包基础设施团队一名工程师下载了被篡改的人工智能 (Artificial Intelligence, AI) 编程工具安装包，9月另一名工程师在虚假招聘的编程“作业”中下载恶意软件，攻击者于10月20日取得另一名工程师机器上的容器部署权限，并于10月29日发动攻击。币安称约28.5亿美元已被冻结或拦截，已补足98%的受影响代币资产，剩余部分正在购回；同时称今年已拦截57起疑似朝鲜相关威胁，并将委托独立安全公司复核事件。
summary.en: Binance said in its initial incident report on November 3 that the roughly $6.34 billion theft was a multi-stage campaign beginning in June: a wallet-infrastructure engineer downloaded a tampered installer for a popular AI coding tool, a second engineer downloaded malware in a coding 'assignment' during a fake job interview in September, attackers found a container deployment permission on another wallet engineer's machine on October 20, and launched the attack on October 29. Binance said about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted, 98% of affected token assets have been replenished with the rest being repurchased, and its team blocked 57 other suspected North Korea-linked threats this year, with independent security firms engaged to review the incident.

title.zh: Solana三季度应用收入近3亿美元环比增50%，稳定币市值创175.1亿美元新高
title.en: Solana Q3 app revenue nears $300 million, up 50%, as stablecoin cap hits record $17.51 billion

summary.zh: Solana官方三季度更新显示，生态应用收入接近3亿美元，较二季度增长约50%，现货去中心化交易所 (Decentralized Exchange, DEX) 交易量达到1,970亿美元，稳定币 (Stablecoin) 市值升至175.1亿美元，创历史新高。开发者参与度同样强劲，Colosseum的Frontier活动收到近2,900个项目投稿，显示建设者兴趣持续。尽管链上指标走强，分析人士提醒，生态增长并不总能同步转化为SOL价格短期上涨，价格走势仍取决于市场情绪与资金面。
summary.en: Solana's official third-quarter update showed ecosystem application revenue of nearly $300 million, up about 50% from the second quarter, spot decentralized exchange (DEX) trading volume of $197 billion, and a stablecoin market capitalization of $17.51 billion, a new all-time high. Developer participation also stayed strong, with nearly 2,900 project submissions to Colosseum's Frontier initiative. Analysts cautioned that stronger on-chain metrics do not always translate into short-term gains for SOL, with price action still driven by market sentiment and liquidity.
